tei:div.tei:p: (95)༄༅// sdig sbyong man ngag bzhugs so//

"$ (96)༄༅// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// sdig pa bshags pa'i thabs la stobs bzhi dang*/ kaṃ ka ni dang*/ yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis ka nas gsungs kyang*/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyang snyam du byang chub tu sems bskyed la rang gi lus 'ja' tshon nam 'od kyi rnam pa lta bur blta ste/ de'i steng du sna'i thad kar bu ga gcig bsams la/ yi ge gsum bzlas pas bu ga na rgyu ma'i tshi ba ji bzhin byung nas/ de nas sdig sgrib thams cad nag nur gyis byung bar sems shing bzla/ de nas 'jog tsa na sangs kyis dag par bsams la/ de thams cad sems kyi snang ba tsam du shes par byas la dge ba bsngo/ smon lam btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs yi ge'i rnam par byon pa yin pas byin rlabs shin tu che/ sde 'khrugs byas pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa chen po yang 'dis 'dag pa yin gsung ngo*// theg pa chen po'i lugs kyi mkhon sbyong lags so// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mi'am mi ma yin pa'i sems can gyi bye brag gang yang rung ba dang*/ sha 'khon du gyur nas de la byang chub kyi sems sbyong snying mi 'dod na byang chub kyi sems su mi 'gyur bas (97)mkhon sbyong ba'i man ngag ni rang stan bde ba la spyod lam gang bder 'dug ste byams snying rje drag pos bskul la rang gi snying khong stong du sha mkhon can de yod par bsams la/ de'i pang na rang gi yi dam gyi lus rang kho na 'dra ba gcig dang kha dang snying dang dpral ba lag pa 'khyud par bsams la/ rang gi spyi bor a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong bdag gi tshangs bug na reg par bsam/

de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gcig bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje sems dpa' de'i thugs byang chub kyi sems snying rje'i ngo bo de rnam pa 'o ma lta bu rdo rje dang hūm̐ las bab nas zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'dzag pa bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs nas snying ga'i gzugs la thim pas tshe thog ma med pa nas kyi sha mkhon dang gdon dang gnod sems dang 'gran sems phrag dog thams cad dag nas pha ma spun zla lta bur skyes par bsam// (98)'jog tsa na rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bo nas mar thim pas rang gzhan thams cad nam mkha' lta bu mnyam pa nyid du bsgom mo// theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi man ngag dam pa'o// jo bo la rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis sems sbyongs shig ces gdams pa'o// na mo rat+na gu ru/ jo bo rje nyid dus khyad par can gcig la byang chub kyi sems sbyong zhing bskor ba mdzad pa na// rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la bud med mi'i lus las ni 'das/ lha'i lus su cung ma slebs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gnyis 'dug pa la gzhon pa la rgan pa des dri ba'i tshul mdzad nas/ myur du sangs rgya bar 'dod pas thabs gang la bslab par bya zhes zhus pas/ myur du sangs rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems sbyong zhes gsungs nas gsang sngags lugs 'di gsungs so// bud med gnyis sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gnyis yin skad/ jo bos dge bshes ston pa la gnang*/ de spyan snga ba la/ des bya yul ba// des gtsang pa rin po che/ des glang lung pa/ des sangs rgyas sgom pa/ zem tshe rin sangs pa/ des sangs rgyas sgom pa byang chub skyabs/ ye shes zhabs shī la badz+ra la/ des don zhabs la/ bud+dha rat+na la lo'i dgon par gnang*/ des kīr+t+ti shī la la/ des dza ya bha dra/

des puṇ+ye rat+na la/ des gzhon nu rgyal mchog dkon mchog 'bangs la'o/ ༈ /ku su lu'i tshogs gsog gi blo sbyong*/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ ku su lu'i tshogs gsog 'di bsod nams che ba yin// 'khor ba dong sprugs byas pa yin/ ku su lu'i tshogs gsog 'di la phan yon brgyad yod gsungs/ lus tha mal gyi zhen pa chod pa dang*/ 'chi ba bslu ba dang*/ dam tshigs nyams pa skong ba dang*/ rmi lam 'bad med du zin (99)pa dang*// gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba dang*/ bar dor dag pa'i sgyu lus ngos zin pa dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa dang*/ smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis gzhan don 'bad med du 'grub pa dang brgyad do// 'di bsgom pa'i dus su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ lus sems gnad dang ldan par byas la/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rnal 'byor ku su lu'i gdams ngag bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ rang gi lus 'di'i nang stong pa rdza ma'i nang lta bur bsgom/ mgrin pa nas tshangs pa'i bu ga man chad bum pa'i mgrin pa ltar skya seng ba gcig bsam/ rang lus stong pa'i thugs kar rang gi sems kyi rnam pa hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de rlung gis yar btegs pas tshangs pa'i bu ga las yar 'thon nam mkha'i sor bzhi tsam na yod par bsams la/ de la dmigs la oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod de rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du gyur par bsam/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lan gsum brjod pas hūm̐ de stong par gyur par bsam/ de'i ngang nas nam mkha' la pad+ma dmar po gcig bsam/ de 'od du zhu ba las pad+ma'i gdan gcig tu gyur/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ dmar po gcig bsam/ bam̐ 'od du zhu ba las gri gug gcig tu gyur/

chang zung yu ba la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ dmar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib dag pas sems can thams cad jo mo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur bar bsam/ 'od zer tshur 'dus gri gug gi yu ba'i bam̐ la thim par (100)bsam/ bam̐ gri gug dang bcas pa zhu nas rang gi sems 'di jo mo'i bris sku 'dra ba gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas nub phyogs bde ba can nas jo mo ye shes pa spyan drangs nas byon par bsam/ dzaḥzhes pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ gis thim/ bam̐ gyis gnyis med du gyur/ hoḥs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje 'dus pa'i sku'i ngo bor gyur pa jo mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang nyid yin aṃ snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ dmar po gcig bsam/ spyi bor a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po gcig bsam/ mgrin par a las zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po gcig bsam/ thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsam/ de rnams la dmigs la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod/ de nas rang lus mi ror gyur pa de rnal 'byor ma'i mdun du ling nge yod par bsams la/ de'i rtsar yaṃ ljang gu gcig bsam/ de 'od du zhu ba las rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'od ma'i gzhu'i dbyibs su yod pa mchog ma gnyis na rlung gi ba dan sngon po re yod par bsam/ de'i chang zung la raṃ dmar ser gcig bsam de'i phyogs re re na hūm̐ sngo skya re re bsam/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu bas mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum yod par bsam/ de nas rang gi sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug des mi ro'i thod pa 'breg mtshams su breg nas mi mgo'i sgyed pu de'i steng du bzhag par bsam/

thod pa de yang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i nang du mi ro de bcug la mi ro de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dal gyi steng du bam̐ bsam/ de 'od du zhu bas gri gug gcig (101)de'i chang zung gi steng na a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas mi ro de bdud rtsir gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi babs pas thod pa gang bar bsam/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'od kyi sna la bdud rtsi sprin 'khrigs pa'i gsab nas bdud rtsi babs pas skya mer gyis gang bar bsam/ gri gug gis dkrugs pas bdud rtsi ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par 'dres par bsam/ gri gug dang yig 'bru rnams bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas rnal 'byor mas hūm̐ lan gsum shangs nas rlung drag po shang shang byung nas ba dan gnyis po la phog nas de gnyis kyis rlung g.yab pas ram̐ las me 'bar bar bsam// de nas bdud rtsi lhog chil gyis khol bar bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas bdud rtsi dkar mer gyis gyur par bsam/ de nas rang rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing nas jo mo rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa byon nas ka pā las bdud rtsi bcus te khyer nas dmyal ba'i gnas su song bas dmyal ba re re'i mgo na yang jo mo re re yod par bsam/ sems can dmyal ba de rnams kyi kha nas mar rang dbang med par blugs pas de thams cad kyi tsha grang gi sdug bsngal zhi nas de rnams thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ lhag ma de pho bas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi zhing du gyur par bsam/ de nas rigs drug ka la des mtshon pas chog pa yin gsungs/ de nas lhag ma de dkon mchog la dbul bar mi 'os na yang bros 'thung gi lhag ma med par dkon mchog la phul na chog pa yin gsungs/

dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ smon lam gdab bo// ༈ /skyid sdug lam khyer gyi blo sbyang*/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skyid sdug lam khyer gyi man ngag (102)ni byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ skyid par byung na skyid mkhan de lus dang sems gang yin ngos yer gyis bzung*/ lus bem po ro dang 'dra ste skyid mkhan ru ma grub/ sems stong pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ste kho nyid kho rang gis stong pas skyid pa po ma grub/ des na skyid pa por 'dzin pa de nyid kho rang gis stong pas stong pa la stong par shes par byas la stong pa'i ngang las sing nge yer re lhod de shag ge sdod tshad mnyam par bzhag /de ni ma bcos dri med chos sku thob pa'i thabs yin no// de'i ngang la skyid par snang ba de nyid rang gi yi dam gang yin de nyid kyi ngo bor yer gyis bsgom/ sems yengs rung ma yengs rung yi dam lha dang 'bral med du rgyas gdab/ de ni dag pa'i gdul bya 'dul byed longs sku thob pa'i thabs yin no// de'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bas skyid par snang ba de nyid sems can gyi don du bsngo ste// skyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo// phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ de ni dag pa'i gdul bya 'dul byed sprul sku thob pa'i thabs yin no// sdug mkhan de lus dang sems gang yin ngos yer gyis bzung*/ lus bem po ro dang 'dra ste sdug mkhan du ma grub/ sems stong pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ste kho nyid kho rang gis stong pas sdug pa por ma grub pas/ des na sdug par 'dzin pa de nyid kho rang gis stong pas stong pa la stong par shes par byas la stong pa'i ngang la sing nge yer re lhod de shig gi sdod tshad du mnyam par bzhag ma bcos dri med chos sku thob pa'i thabs yin no// de'i ngang la sdug par 'dzin pa de nyid rang gi yi dam gang yin pa de'i ngo bor yer gyis bsgom/

sems yengs rung ma yengs rung yi dam lha dang 'bral med du rgyas gdab/ de ni dag pa'i gdul bya 'dul byed longs sku thob pa'i thabs yin no// de'i (103)nga rgyal dang ma bral bas sdug par snang ba de nyid sems can gyi don du bsngo ste/ sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal blang*// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ de ni ma dag pa'i gdul bya 'dul byed sprul sku thob pa'i thabs yin no// skyid sdug lam khyer gyi man ngag go /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ mkhan chen lho brag pa/ mkhan chen bde ba byams chen po// rin po che grags pa bshes gnyen/ chos rje bsod nams rin chen/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog go ༈ /sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud kyi blo sbyong*/ gu ru na mo// grub thob sum pa lo tsā ba rgya gar du byon/ gsang sngags phal cher la thos pa mdzad/ bod du byon khar gser lhag ma khyer nas rdo rje gdan du byang chub chen po la 'bul du byon/ gan+dho la la bskor ba mdzad cing bzhugs pas bud med dmar mo gcig dang sngon mo gcig gnyis res 'ga' bar snang la bskor ba mdzad/ res 'ga' sa la gom pa 'dor ba'i tshul du bskor ba mdzad cing gda' skad/ der bud med sngon mo des dmar mo de la/ mo de mdangs zhag blo yang ma bde 'gro snying gcig kyang 'dod 'chi ba min na drag ste// lar 'chi ba 'di ka la 'tsher zer nas dri ba rnam pa bzhi byed kyin gda' skad/ der bud med dmar mo des lo tsā ba la spyan gyis zur mig cer ba cig gzigs nas sngon mo de la/ mo de gang byung gis chog na ci byas kyang bde ste/ khyod kyi blo de gang byung gis mchog pas lan pa yin no// mo de sems bzhag sar sdod na phyin chog kyang chog ste/ khyod kyi sems de bzhag sar ma sdod pas lan no// mo de blo chos su song na shi yang sla ba la khyod kyi blo rgyun chos su ma song bas lan no// mo de rang sems skye med du rtogs na (104)'chi rgyu yang med de khyod kyi sems de skye med du ma rtogs pas lan zer nas lan rnam bzhi 'debs kyin gda' skad/

de nas lo tsā ba'i thugs skya bsangs// sngar bslabs pa'i chos gnad du song*/ thugs rgyud kyi steng du yang rtogs pa khyad par can skyes pa yin gsung ngo*// de la ngo sprod 'di ltar du yin/ gang byung gi chog na bya ba/ rang gi bsags pa dang bstun pa'i longs spyod gang byung gis chog shes gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa la phrag mi dog /rkyen bde sdug gi khong zhums su mi 'gyur ba la sogs dgos gsung ngo*// sems bzhag sar sdod pa bya ba/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang thabs khyad par can la brten nas sems rang ngo shes/ rang sa zin/ rang dbang thob pa la sogs pa dgos// sems chos dang 'dres pa ni/ sems ni rig rig po 'di yin/ chos de'i rang bzhin rtogs pa gcig dgos/ sems skye med du rtogs pa ni/ skye ba rtogs pa 'chi ba 'gag pa yin/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mnyam rjes med pa ni 'chi rgyu med pa lags so// chos 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma rdo rje phag mo dang sgrol ma gnyis kyis sum pa lo tsā ba la gsungs/ des sa paṇa/ des grub thob chen po mtsho 'phrad pa/ des mkhas grub chos rje/ des ri khrod ras chen/ des pra dz+nyā bo dhi/ des don zhags pa/ bud+dha rat+na la/ des kīr+t+ti shī la la/ des chos rje rgyal ba bzang po la/ des chos rje bsod nams la gnang*/ des dkon mchog 'bangs la gnang ba'o/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i blo sbyong*/ gu ru mai tri na mo// bla ma'i zhal nas chos thams cad rang gi sems steng du hril gyis dril nas nyams su len dgos/ de yang bka' brgyud 'di bla ma'i lam yin pas dus gsum/ (105)gyi mchod yul thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma de'i rnam 'phrul du shes par byas nas blo sbyong bas bla ma la phyag dang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa 'bul gsol ba btab/ bla ma de la sna thag gtad nas mi rtag pa nas gnas lugs kyi bar nyams su len dgos/

de yang lta ba rnam par dag pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye 'gag med cing spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gtan la phab/ 'gag med kyi rtsal sbyong sems can la dmigs pa chos tsam la dmigs pa dmigs pa med pa gsum bsgom/ mnyam pa nyid gsum bsgom/ des nye ring med pa gus pa bzang ngan med pa yon tan gsum bskyed/ gzhan yang rlabs po che'i sems dang mi bsgul ba'i sems dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i sems dang gsum la bslab/ de la dang po ni/ theg pa chen po'i sems 'ba' zhig ste/ gcung mos pas gcen po thams cad kyi mdzad pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang phrin las la sogs pa rnams gcen po thams cad dang mnyam par gyur cig /ces thugs bskyed pas thams cad dang mnyam pa dang*/ shākya thub pas kyang sems can thams cad bya byed ngan pa rang bzhin ngan pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdul byar ma gyur pa rnams ngas 'dul bar gyur cig /ces thugs rlabs po che bskyed/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad/ rigs gsum mgon po thugs rje chen pos dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang bzhin du shar nas stong gsum khong gi rnam 'phrul ji ltar yin pa'am/ 'khor ba'i gnas su thugs rje'i rlabs dpag tu med pa la sogs pa gsungs/ phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' shugs 'chang du skye ba bzhes pa'i dus su'ang sangs rgyas pa theg pa chen po'i lam (106)ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu 'khor bar bsdad nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal ba'i grogs byed/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad/ sangs rgyas mchod pas mnyes par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rdzogs par byed pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba 'dzin bdud 'dul bar chad bsrung ba la sogs pa rlabs po che'i spyod pa mdzad/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dang po thugs bskyed pa'i dus su byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad bzhin du sems can sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par dam bcas/

sems can byang chub la bkod nas phyogs bcu'i so sor sangs rgyas ma thob bar de srid du sangs mi rgya bar dam bcas/ sems can re re'i rgyas kyang phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par bya/ sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med la sogs kyi sdug bsngal gyis mi skyo byang chub sems dpa'i rten la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad par dam bcas/ dam bca' de ma rdzogs par sangs rgyas na de'i mtshams med pa lnga byed cing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bslus par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ de thams cad pas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rlabs che ste/ dang po thugs bskyed pa'i dus su dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis thugs ji ltar bskyed par ma nus pa'i thugs rjes su bskyed de/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i dus su dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dka' ba ci spyod pa ma lus par spyod cing nam mkha'i mthas gtug pa'i sems can ma lus pa sangs rgyas la 'god par 'dod pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i rten la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing re rer yang de'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i dus su sems can re re'i don du yang bskal pa (107)dpag tu med par mnar med la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong zhing dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa zhal gyis bzhes/ dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems ma bskyed pa rnams bdag gis bskyed/ spyod par mi nus pa'i dka' ba bdag gis spyad/ thugs rje chen po thabs la mkhas pa rnams kyis spangs pa'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i thugs bskyed sangs rgyas re re'i mdun du lus 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dbul/ lus re re yang zhing khams dpag med gcig sbyang*/ de bzhin du sems can smin dka' ba spyod pa gdul dka' ba rnams 'dul ba'i smon lam 'debs/

sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes/ kha cig re re la dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rdzogs par mdzad/ bsam pa de yongs su ma rdzogs par sangs rgyas na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par gyur cig ces smon lam btab te/ de'i thugs bskyed ni nam mkha' lta bu ste brjod kyis mi lang ngo*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams pas kyang rgya che bar rang cag gis sems bskyed/ byang chub kyi sems de dang po la brten nas skye/ bar du gnas/ tha mar sangs rgyas skyo bar mi bya/ 'di sdug gi mgo mthud/ skyid kyi kha bsnon/ 'jigs pa'i skyel ma nad dang gdon gyi gnyen po nyon mongs 'bur 'joms yin pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi rjes su bslab pa'i phyir rang tha mal pa'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ dkar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer zing zing 'phros te song bas nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa'i sems can thams (108)cad la phog pas sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ phrag dog ser sna la sogs pa drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa/ nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa de rnams kyis kun nas slong ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu mtshams med lnga de dang nye ba lnga/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba dkon mchog la ma gus pa/ dam pa'i chos spong ba// 'phags pa la skur ba btab pa la sogs pas rgyu de las mtho ris thar pa'i gegs byed pa 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal nyams su blang dgos pa thams cad rang gi lus la sib sib byung nas sems can gyi rgyud la sgrib pa med par gtsang sing gis song nas/ da sdig pa de dag bshags par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ yang 'od zer bskyar ma gcig 'phros te song bas sems can thams cad la phog pas 'bras bu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/

dmyal ba tsha grang*/ yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro glen lkugs la sogs pa/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ba dang ltung ba/ mi la sdug bsngal brgyad dam bcu gcig la sogs pa lus ngag yid gsum la gnod pa'i mi dge ba thams cad la 'od zer gyis sems can rnams kyi lus sems bde sangs song bar bsam/ 'od zer rang gi lus la thim pas sdug bsngal de dag rang gi lus la sib kyis byung nas ba spu'i bu ga re re yang mnar med pa la sogs pa'i rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas par bsam/ sems can sdug bsngal dang bral na bdag gis 'khur du yod pa don che snyam du bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi bdag nyid gnya' bo'am gta' mar yid ches bzhin pas bdag gtes par bcug (109)la sems can bslu/ bdag gis sdug bsngal thams cad nyams su blangs la sems can thams cad bde ba la dgod do snyam du bsam/ yang 'od zer bskyar ma gcig 'phros nas song bas rang gi bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang yi dam gyi lha dang nyan rang rnams kyi rgyud la phog pas de dag gi thugs dam gyi bar chad dang*/ sku chags dang thugs dgongs ma rdzogs pa dang rnam par thar pa mthar ma phyin pa la sogs pa thams cad 'od zer gyi sna la sib sib 'dus nas rang gi lus la sib sib byung bar bsam/ de bdag gis khur du yod pa bsod nams che snyam du bsam/ dus rtag tu nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ma g.yos par bya/ rtag tu bla ma yid la byed pa dang ma bral bar bya/ de dag la lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba mchod par 'bul/ sems can thams cad kyi lan chags dang sha mkhon yod pa'i bgegs rnams la de dag gi glud du grangs mang por ro zhim pa gzugs bzang bar sprul te de bzhin du khrag rus pa don snying yan lag dang nying lag dpag tu med par sprul la gang 'dod la blos byin/ rings na rjen par/

mi rings na tshos la zo bya/ zos pa thams cad nyon mongs pa'i sred pa zhi nas bde ba rgyas te bdag gi gdul byar gyur par smon lam btab/ la la da res btang ba'i dus min zer te/ mi gtsang pa'i lus bsrung ba 'di gcer bu tsher ma khur ba dang 'dra ste klod na bde gsungs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis dpag tu med pa bsags pas bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis tshogs gnyis dpag tu med pa 'phel nas 'phags pa thams cad kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig /(110)sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi nas bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ snying po dang drag las byed pa'i dus su yang rang yi dam lhar bskyed la sdig pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis lus thams cad thal ba rdul du brlag nas sems can rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god par bsam/ yang rang la gnad gcod dang cho 'phrul byung ba'i dus su nyam nga thams cad dang bral ba skye ba med par thag bcad nas snang ba thams cad gzugs brnyan du shes par byas nas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag gsungs/ rang gi rgyud la nyon mongs pa skyes na de'i rang bzhin skye med du shes par byas la nyon mongs pa ye shes su bsgyur/ rkyen ngan dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs ci byung yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs su blo sbyong*/ de nas zas gos gnas khang thams cad la byang chub sems kyi grogs su longs spyod/ sems can gang gis bdag mthong ba dang thos pa dran pa gtam du brjod pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa gsum zad nas sku gsum thob pa'i rgyu la 'bad par bya'o// 'gal rkyen thams cad yang dag pa'i lam du blangs nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa spyad/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang phrin las dang smon lam dang rlabs po che'i spyod pa bdag gis rdzogs par bya snyam du bsam mo// mi sgul ba'i sems ni nya pa zhing pa tshong sa sogs kyis tsha grang gnod pa bzod na bdag lta 'gro ba bde phyir cis mi bzod skad pas sems can gyi don byed pa la sdig pa nyon mongs pa tshe 'di'i rtog pa theg pa dman pa dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad kyis mi bsgul mi bskyod par thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa gcig dgos/

rdo rje lta bu'i sems ni da nas sangs rgyas ma thob (111)bar du rnam par rtog pa gang gis kyang bar du ma chod par byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin/ de yang thabs shes rab dbyer med yin te gcig bsgom tsa na gnyis rang chas su 'ong bas zung 'jug tu bsgom// sangs rgyas tsa na yon tan zhing khams rgya che chung 'ongs pa lta bu'i mthu stobs dang*/ smon lam gyi khyad par las byung bas da lta byams pas khyab tshad ma 'ongs pa na gdul byar 'gyur bas de yang sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i sems bskyed dka' ba spyod lam la bslabs pas nam mkha'i ngang du sangs rgyas nas sprul pas sems can 'khor ba las grol bar byas pa tsam du bslab/ de yang nam mkhas nam mkha' yul du byas pa tsam mo// de ltar nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du thag bcad nas sgyu ma'i rnam par 'phrul par shes nas 'gag med kyi rtsal byang chub kyi sems rlabs po che sbyang*/ tshogs gnyis sgyu ma lta bur gsog pa de zung 'jug go// don nang du shar bas 'khor bar mi skyo/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi ring ba gcig yong ba yin gsungs/ de tsa na re dogs dang bral chos skur rtogs pas mnar med du phyin kyang bde ba can du 'char/ 'khor 'das gnyis med du rtogs pas blang dor gyi blo dang bral/ sangs rgyas dang sems can dbyer med du rtogs pas bzang ngan gyi 'dzin pa zhig /chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas theg pa mtho dman du 'dzin pa'i phyogs cha dang bral ma phyin par klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa'i steng du slebs/ de lta bu'i chos la sleb par 'dod pas sbyor ba tshogs bsags/ bsam pas blo sbyang*/ mos pas yul du bya/ zhen pas 'jug 'brel pas mi bslu/ khad nas rtogs par 'gyur ro// de nas tshe rabs thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i phyir nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i (112)chos bzhi bsgrub pa la bslab/ rtag tu sems can mi spang ba'i phyir blo sbyong spong ba'i rgyu bzhi spong pa la bslab/

rgyu bzhi ni sems can mang po 'di tsam gyi don byed mi nus snyam na ji ltar mang ba ltar byang chub kyi sems rgya cher spel lo// byed ngan pa spang ba ni/ lus kyi grogs sum btub kyang dus gtan du byas la blo bsdu/ 'khor ba'i yul mthong bas spang ba ni/ sdug bsngal mang zhing mang ba ltar de rnams bsgral zhing 'don par byed dgos so// stong pa nyid mthong bas spang ba ni/ ji ltar stong pa yin pa de bzhin ma rtogs par dngos por 'dzin nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong ba snying rje snyam nas spong ba'i rgyu bzhi spang ste sems can la snying rje je che je che la btang*/ de ltar thams cad la snyoms pa'i byang chub kyi sems sgom tsa na/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes so// byang chub sems de 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes par bya ba la bslab/ dran pa dang shes bzhin du bsrung ba 'phags pa ka t+yā ya na bzhin du bslab/ de ltar sgyu ma lta bur spyod pa'i gang zag des rloms pa med pas gzugs brnyan gyi skye bo lta bu/ lan la mi re ba rang gi lag pas kha la zan byin pa lta bu/ rnam smin la mi re ba sgyu ma'i skyes bu lta bu/ lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa bas bsdus pa ltos pa med par btang bas sangs rgyas lta bu dgos skad/ de yang bsam pa dag pas thong nges su bya/ dngos su btang ba'i dus min ma 'ongs pa na rtsol ba med par lhun grub tu byang chub sems dpa'i rten la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gcig 'ongs/ sangs rgyas nas rang don chos sku brnyes nas gzhan don du (113)gzugs sku gnyis kyis zhing khams dag ma dag 'dres ma gsum gyi don 'khor ba ma stong bar du 'byung gsungs// gsang sbas so// jo bo// dpal ldan dgon pa ba/

rin chen sne zur pa/ gyer sgom sangs rgyas dbon/ zang dgon pa/ mkhan po chos ldan/ slob dpon shākya bkra shis/ rgya ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bud+dha rat+na la/ kīr+t+ti shī la la/ dza ya bha dra la/ puṇ+ye rat+na la/ mi pham chos kyi rje la gnang ngo*/ ༈ /blo sbyong thun brgyad ma lags so// theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir jo bo la sngags pha rol tu phyin pa gsan pa'i bla ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod/ khyad par gyis kyang byang chub sems ston pa'i bla ma gsum yod/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ dharma rak+ṣi ta/ gser gling pa dang gsum yin/ de rnams kyi nang nas bla ma gser gling pa la gus pa'i rgyu mtshan bla ma gzhan la gdung khang med de/ gser gling pa la gdung khang dngul gdugs can yod/ bla ma gzhan la zla mchod med de/ gser gling pa la zla mchod yod/ bla ma gzhan gyi mtshan thos tsam gyis thal mo thugs kar sbyor te/ mnyam med gser gling pa'i mtshan thos tsam na thal mo spyi bor sbyor/ bla ma gzhan dran kyang spyan chab mi 'ong ste/ bla ma gser gling pa dran tsam nas spyan chab yod skad/ a ti sha la bla ma mang du yod pa la gser gling pa la de tsam gus pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'di bla ma gser gling pa min pa la ma byung ba yin gsungs/ bla ma gser gling pa de'i brgyud pa'i dbang du byas na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags (114)pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ des mchog gi sde/ des dul ba'i sde/ des mkhan po yang dag rnam snang mdzad/ des seng ge bzang po// des rin chen mdo/ des bla ma gser gling pa/ des dpal ldan a ti sha*/des dge bshes ston pa/ des sku mched gsum la/ khyad par du spyan snga ba la gnang*/ des glang thang pa dang*/ sha bo sgang pa gnyis la/ glang thang pas zhang zhung dang lu gur gnyis la/

de gnyis kyis phyis jo bo la/ des lung nang pa mkhan po rin po che/ des slob dpon brag ston shes rab rin chen/ bstan pa'i bdag po slob dpon gzhon nu bsam gtan/ des bud+dha rat+na/ des kīr+t+ti shī la la/ des rgyal ba'i mtshan/ des pu ṇ+ye rat+na la/ des gzhon nu rgyal mchog /de yan chad bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa yin te/ de rnams chos 'di la brten nas grub pa thob/ rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs pa yin gsungs/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong zhes bya ba spyir du yang bka' sde snod kyi chos thams cad nas gsungs/ khyad par gyis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bsam gtan le'u nas/ bdag nyid skyon bcas gzhan la yang*// yon tan rgya mtshor shes byas nas// bdag 'dzin yongs su dor ba dang*// gzhan blang ba yang bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de rnams kyi don go hril gyis dril ba la spyir 'khor bar 'khyams par byed pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong de tshur bsdu na/ drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa/ nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa de'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa gcig la nga bdag tu bzung nas 'di'i kha 'dzin shag 'debs byas pas tshe 'di la dge rgyu'i las mi dge bar song nas mi (115)dge'i rgyu'i las sdug bsngal du song nas rang sa rang gis kha 'dzin shag 'debs byas pas lan/ de 'og man chad du yang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di ma spangs na de kho na bzhin du 'khyams pa 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du sdug tu 'jug mkhan rang gces par 'dzin pa'i 'gong po nga bdag bya ba 'di yin min la the tshom mi za/ 'di yi kha 'dzin shag 'debs byas pas lan/ mthong ba thos pa yid la 'gyus pa rnams lag len la ma btab pa gcig kyang med de/ 'khor ba la snga 'dris gang yang ring du ma song bas da yang gang legs thong byug legs la thong snyam du byas nas rang gzhan ling bskyur la thong lhod de klod la thong*/

shigs kyis shig la thong*/ sems can spyir mi yong ba min pha ma drin can sha dag yin pas sems can rnams kyi rgyu'i dus kyi sdig pa/ 'bras bu'i dus kyi sdug bsngal ko ba spyi gris bzhar ba bzhin du blangs nas rang gi lus po 'di'i steng du hril hril smin par bsam/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba sems can la smin par bsam/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang blos blangs nas sems can la smin par bsgom/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhes bya ba'i don go de lta bu gcig yin gsungs/ mkhan po ba'i gsung nas blo sbyong zhes bya ba bdag khyad du bsad nas sems can la gus/ bdag khyad par du bsad pa bya ba 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sdug tu 'jug mkhan rang gces par 'dzin pa'i 'gong po 'di yin pas gzhi 'di brlag na yang brlag gzhug gsungs/ don du ma la 'jug gsungs/ sems can la gus par bsgom pa ni gzhan khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can 'di rnams cir (116)mi yong ba ma yin/ pha ma drin can sha stag yin pas sems can la gus par bsgom lus ngag yid gsum gyi zho sha mi bsri bar phan 'dogs gsung ngo*/ ༈ /zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong*// yang dge bshes ston pa'i gdams ngag lag len du byed na/ sbyin bdag gi bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'am gzhan gyi dad zas 'ju bar bya ba'i ched du zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong bgyi ba/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ khyad par gyis kyang rang gi lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pas de rnams da lta zang zing gis sdud la ma 'ongs pa na chos kyis sdud snyam du bsam// zas nang du mid pa'i dus su sems can rnams kyi rgyu'i dus kyi sdig pa 'bras bu'i dus kyi sdug bsngal thams cad ko ba spyi gris bzhar ba bzhin du rang gi lus 'di'i steng du hril gyis smin par bsgom/

dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i dus su rang gi bde ba dang dge ba sems can la bsngo bar bsgom/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang blos blangs nas sems can la smin par bsgom/ de ltar sems can rnams kyi rgyu dus kyi sdig pa 'bras bu'i dus kyi sdug bsngal bral/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas thob par bsgom/ yang rgyu'i dus kyi sdig pa 'bras bu'i dus kyi sdug bsngal dang bral byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo bar krong nge gyur par bsgom/ de nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba gcig spyi bo'i gtsug tu byon par bsgom/ de la yid kyi sgo nas dad pa gus pa byed/ ngag gi sgo nas (117)bstod pa byed mchod pa 'bul gsol ba gdab/ de nas tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar thim thim song nas stong pa nyid du cham cham snying gi thad kar slebs tsam na stong pa nyid du cham gyur par bsgom/ de'i ngang du 'bol le shigs se lhod de khril le bzhag /de'i 'phro la sems gnas na gnas su gzhug /de'i 'phro la gnyid du song na gnyid chos nyid du khyer ba'i man ngag yin/ de'i 'phro la shi na 'chi kha ma'i man ngag yin te bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob gsung ngo*// de'i 'phro la bzlas pa byed na byin rlabs shin tu che ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa 'gro ba ma lus yi dam lha bsgom pa de sku'i bzlas pa/ snying po bzlas pa de gsung gi bzlas pa yin/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa de thugs kyi bzlas pa yin gsungs/ de las ldang bar 'dod na nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon chags pa bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi ngang las bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba lam ste bskyed/ sngar bstims pa'i sems dpa' tshon gang pa de spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhugs par bsams la/

yid kyi sgo nas dad pa dang gus pa bya/ ngag gi sgo nas bstod pa bya mchod pa 'bul gsol ba gdab/ de nas ras bris yod na de la bstim/ med na lugs ma'am gdung rten la bstim/ de lta bu mi bzhugs na rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi bsngo ba lan gsum bya/ da lta'i snang ba 'di rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom gsungs/ zas la brten pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ ༈ /dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong*/ gnyis pa dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong ni/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du dbugs la brten pa'i (118)blo sbyong bsgom snyam du bsam nas dbugs nang du rgyu ba'i dus su sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rang la smin par bsgom/ dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i dus su rang gi bde ba dang dge ba sems can rnams la smin par bsgom/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba blos blangs nas sems can la smin par bsgom/ de ltar rang yang sdig sdug dang bral byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas sngar bzhin byas/ dbugs la bsten pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// gsum pa lus gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i blo sbyong bgyi pa/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du lus gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas sems can dmyal ba pa rnams kyi sdig sdug thams cad rang gi lus po de rnams kyi thog tu hril hril smin par bsgom/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad sems can dmyal ba rnams la smin par bsgom/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang blos blangs nas sems can dmyal ba pa rnams la smin par bsgom/

de ltar sems can dmyal ba pa rnams sdig sdug dang bral/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas mtho ris lha mi thob par bsgom// de ltar yid btags dud 'gro lha ma yin rnams kyis kyang lha mi'i lus thob par bsgom// mi'i gnas su lus gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas mi rnams kyi sdig sdug thams cad rang gi lus po de rnams kyi steng du hril hril smin par bsgom// rang gi bde dge mi rnams la smin par bsgom/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa (119)ba rnams kyang blos blangs nas sems can rnams la smin par bsgom/ de ltar mi rnams sdig sdug dang bral byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas par bsgom/ de nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba gcig tu bsgom/ rang gi lus dum bur gtubs la sha khrag gis khengs par bsgom/ de la dmigs la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas kyang khengs par bsgom/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud rtsi dang bcud kyis khengs par bsgom/ de nas bdud rtsi rnams dang po bla ma yi dam gyi lha la 'bul/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul/ de nas rigs drug rnams la phul bas/ de rnams thams cad kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos sku brnyes par bsam/ de ltar lus ni sems can la drangs nas med/ sems la ni rang bzhin grub pa med pa'i ngang la lhan gyis bzhag /yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas sngar bzhin bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ lus gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// bzhi pa sha khrag la brten pa'i blo sbyong zhes bgyi ba/

sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sha khrag la bsten pa'i blo sbyong snyam du bsams nas/ de nas rang gi khang pa sha khrag gis khengs par bsams la/ yid btags sha khrag la dga' ba thams cad 'dus 'dus byas pas 'dus par bsgom/ de nas sha la dga' bas sha zo/ khrag la dga' bas khrag 'thung*/ mgo ya bdud rgyal pos khyer/ rkang pa ma bdud (120)rgyal mos khyer/ bar rnams lha 'dre gnyen dgus khyer/ rings pa na rjen par zo/ mi ring pa na tshos la zo/ thabs ji ltar legs pa bzhin du gyis byas nas byin pas sha zos khrag 'thung rus pa kun yang mur bar bsam/ de ltar lus ni khong rnams la byin nas med sems la ni rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du lhan ne 'jog pa yin/ de nas blo rgya cher song nas lcags ri'i nang gang tsam/ lung pa gang tsam/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sha khrag gis kheng par bsgom pa yin gsungs/ de nas ldang bar 'dod na dge ba bsngo/ rmi lam lta bur bsgom/ sha khrag gtong ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// lnga pa gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong bgyi ba/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong bya snyam du bsams nas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba gcig tu bsgom/ rang gi lus dum bur gtubs la snod khengs par bsgoms nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur bar bsgom/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la sogs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod byas pas dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma dpal mgon dang lha mo la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis bskor nas gsol ba bsam la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te sam bha ra sam bha ra hūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas sangs rgyas bstan srung rnams kyis gsol bar bsam/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs par gyur cig ces brjod/

bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ zhes pa'i tshig brjod/ de ltar lus ni (121)drangs nas med/ sems la ni rang bzhin med pas rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du lhan gyis bzhag /de nas ldang bar 'dod na dge ba bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ gtor ma la brten pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// drug pa 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong bgyi ba/ spyod 'jug las/ sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /ces gsungs pas/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'byung ba la bsten pa'i blo sbyong bsgom snyam du bsams nas/ rang gi lus po 'di sha dang rus pa rnams phyi'i 'byung ba sa la thim par bsgom/ khrag dang chu ser rnams chu la thim par bsgom/ dbugs rnams rlung la thim par bsgom/ drod rnams me la thim par bsgom/ lus 'byung ba bzhir gyur pa 'dis sas sra zhing brtan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ chus brlan cing gsher ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ mes tsha zhing sreg pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ rlung gis yang zhing g.yo ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis mig gnyis su byas nas sems can gyi don byed pa yin te sems can zas za ba rnams rang gi sha za bar bsgom/ gos gyon pa rnams rang gi pags pa gyon par bsgom/ skom 'thung ba rnams rang gi khrag 'thung bar bsgom/ de nas sems can rnams kyi sdig sdug rang la smin par bsgom/ rang gi bde dge thams cad sems can la smin par bsgom/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang blos blangs nas sems can la smin par bsgom/ de ltar sems (122)can rnams sdig sdug dang bral byang chub tu sems bskyed nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis dag nas sangs rgyas par bsgom/

'byung ba bzhi'i lus la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur bar bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas kyang khengs par bsgom/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang byang sgra mi snyan dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud rtsi dang bcud du gyur pa thams cad kyis kyang khengs par bsgom/ de dang po bla ma dang yi dam la dbul/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul/ de nas rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phul bas de rnams kyi bdud rtsi rnams ma lus par sangs kyis gsol bar bsam/ de rnams kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku thob par bsgom/ de ltar lus ni bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs drug rnams la phul nas med/ sems ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa'i ngang nas lhan gyis 'jog pa yin gsungs/ yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas sngar bzhin bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong gi le'u ste drug pa'o/// /bdun pa lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher bsgyur ba'i blo sbyong zhes bgyi ba/ spyod 'jug las// yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i don du lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher sprul pa'i blo sbyong bsgom snyam du bsams nas/ de nas rang gi lus po 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che kha dog sngon po dbyibs brgyad (123)gzhog che chung mi 'bring po'i brla tsam gcig tu gyur par bsgom/ de rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags nas mchod pa phul te gsol ba btab pas mi mnyam pa'i char gcig babs/

des sa gzhi la chag chag btab par bsgom/ yang mchod pa phul nas gsol ba btab pas mi mnyam pa'i rlung gcig langs/ des sa gzhi la phyag dar byas par bsgom/ yang mchod pa phul nas gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i char babs pas sems can rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang tha mal gyi sha khrag thug par sbyong nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas par bsgom/ yang mchod pa phul nas gsol ba btab pas rin po che'i char babs pas de rnams la rin po che'i rgyan gdags par bsgom/ yang mchod pa phul nas gsol ba btab pas lha'i na bza' pañca li kā'i char bab pas de rnams la na bza' gsol bar bsam/ yang mchod pa phul nas gsol ba btab pas zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i char babs pas 'jig rten gyi khams khengs par bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi babs pas kyang khengs par bsgom/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang sgra mi snyan dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud rtsi dang bcud du gyur pa thams cad kyis kheng par bsgom/ de yang dang po de bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha la 'bul/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul/ de nas rigs drug sangs rgyas pa de rnams la phul bas de rnams kyi bdud rtsid lhag ma ma lus par sangs kyis gsol bas de thams cad kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku thob par bsgom/ de ltar lus ni bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rigs drug sangs rgyas pa rnams (124)la dbul/ sems la ni rang bzhin grub pa med pas rang bzhin ma grub pa'i ngang la lhan gyis 'jog /de nas ldang bar 'dod na dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher bsgyur ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// brgyad pa blo sbyong 'chi kha ma'i man ngag bgyi ba/ 'chi ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgo nas 'chi dgos pa yin/

'chi ba'i dus su yo byad sum cha gsum du bgos la cha gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ cha gcig tshogs sog byed/ cha gcig la bkye bkang la sogs pa ci rigs su byed pa yin gsungs/ de sbyin pa yin/ tshul khrims la so sor thar pa'i ltung ba bshags sdom byed/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed sor 'jug byed/ de tshul khrims yin/ bzod pa sngar mkhon yod na bzod gsol byed/ rtsa na med na ka cha rna cha gcig tsam bsngos nas 'o cag gnyis 'di lta bu gcig yod pas bzod pa mdzod zer/ khos bzod pa len du ma btub na rang gi sems la mi bde ba med par byed pa yin/ brtson 'grus de rnams byed pa thams cad dga' spro dang bcas pas byed pa yin/ bsam gtan dang shes rab gnyis 'di'i khog na yod/ de nas dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa grub na rgyas par byed/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byed/ bdag gi rgyud la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blo sbyong brjed pa'i gnas bzhir mi brjed par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'chor ba'i gnas bzhir mi 'chor bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas dkon mchog gi spyan sngar yi ge baṃ dmar ser gcig bsgom/ de 'od du zhu bas pad+ma'i sdong po gcig tu gyur par bsgom/ pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru rin po che dar zab kyis brgyan pa la (125)bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha thams cad par bsgom la/ sngar gyi mchod pa de rnams blos blangs nas dbul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab/ de nas sa phyogs dben par 'bol ba'i gdan la lus rnam snang chos bdun nam bsam gtan gyi chos drug la bslab zer nas rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'/ rgal tshig gser gyi dong rtse brtsegs pa bzhin du drang tig ste bsrang*/ lag pa gnyis lte ba'i thad nas sor bzhi tsam gzhal ba'i sar mnyam par bzhag

/mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar bkug cing rgyab mdud gtam gsungs/ g.yon phyogs su chus chus pa lan gsum tsam byas pa'i sna chu thig pa lte ba'i thad kar yong tsam byed/ mig sna rtse la gtad/ so bar rta rnga shong ba tsam byed// lce ya rkan la sbyor/ mig btsum pa'ang min btsum na bying nas 'gro/ bsgrad pa'ang min bsgrad na yengs nas 'gro/ lha'i spyan ltar zim zim du bya/ de nas shes pa de lte ba'i thad kar chil chil ba lan gsum byed pa yin gsungs/ de nas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag bsgom snyam du bsams nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di thams cad las dge mi dge mi g.yo ba'i las gsum las 'byung*/ de nyon mongs pa kun nas blangs pa las byung*/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong de'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin pas rang bzhin grub pa med pa gcig la nga bdag tu bzung nas 'di'i kha 'dzin shag 'debs byed byed nas las bsags/ las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la thug pa med cing mtha' mi mngon pa gcig nyams su myong*/ tshe 'di la yang kha 'dzin shag 'debs byas pa de rgyu las sdug bsngal du song ba'am/ dge rgyu las mi dge bar song bas rang sa rang gi (126)kha 'dzin dang shag 'debs byas pas lan/ de man chad du yang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di ma spangs na snga mkhon bzhin du 'khor bar 'khyams pas 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du sdug tu 'jug mkhan rang la gces par 'dzin pa'i 'gong po nga bdag bya ba 'di yin min la the tshom mi za/ 'di'i kha 'dzin shag 'debs pas pas phan na mthong ba thos pa yid la 'gyu ba rnams lag len du ma btab pa gcig kyang med de 'khor ba las sngar 'dres gang yang ring du ma song bas da gang legs legs la thong dbyug legs la thong snyam du bgyis la rang bzhin ling bskyur lhod de klod/

shigs kyis bshig la zhog /gzhan khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can 'di rnams spyir mi yong ba min drin can gyi pha ma sha stag kyang yin pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal rang la smin par bsgom/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba sems can la smin par bsgom/ de ltar sems can sdig sdug dang bral nas sangs rgyas par bsgom/ rang yang sdig sdug bral nas yi dam gyi lha'i bsgom bzlas gong dang mthun/ de nas dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa grub na rgyas par byed/ yan lag bdun pa grub na rgyas par byed/ bdag gi rgyud la theg pa chen po blo sbyang gi rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blo sbyong brjed pa'i gnas bzhir mi brjed par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'chor ba'i gnas bzhir mi 'chor bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas 'chi ba rang gi dus su phyi dbugs chad pa'i dus su sems gsal la rtog pa med pa ston ka'i nam mkha' sprin bral ba lta bu sems can thams cad la yang*/ de dang sngar gyi de gnyis gung bsgrigs pa yin/ gung 'grigs na chu sna dang breng 'phrad pa bzhin du song nas de la lo'am zla ba tsam du gnas nas bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur ldang ba yin te brtson 'grus can mthong chos la sangs rgya ba yin gsungs/ der ma zin na bar do'i chos lus su ldang ba yin te bar do byis pa lo lnga lon pa'i tshod tsam gcig 'ongs/ kha (127)dogs rnam pa lnga'i tshul du yod de sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang gnyis su med par shes na dug lnga ye shes lngar gyur nas 'gro ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang mnyam nyid ye shes gnyis chos kyi sku/ me long lta bu longs sku/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes gnyis sprul pa'i sku'o// 'od kha dog lnga po de la chags shing mngon par zhen na dug lngar gnas gyur nas rgyu drug tu 'khor zhing rigs drug tu 'khyams skye ba len pa yin gsung ngo*// lar skye ba 'di'am bdun nam bcu drug thug pas sangs rgyas pa yin gsung ste 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa la ltos na sang gnang gi tshod tsam yin gsungs/

shin tu le lo can skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgyas par bya ba yin gsungs/ thun brgyad ma'i man ngag dge legs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/ ༈ /gegs sel blo sbyong bzhugs so// bla ma thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi gegs sel ni/ ltas ngan g.yang du len/ bdud srid du gcod/ bar chad lam du 'jug /mi mkho shos la 'dod thog tu byed pa yin gsungs/ dang po ni 'jig rten pas srin bya'am wa brgyal ba la sogs pa ltas ngan pa byung ba'i dus su rtsis byed mo 'debs cho ga byed pa yin te/ 'o cag ltas dang mtshan ma ngan pa byung ba'i dus su sdug tu 'jug mkhan bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ltas ngan pa byung gis dogs pa'i sdug bsngal bdag la smin bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di brlag tu chug cig snyam du len pa yin/ gnyis pa ni sdug tu 'jug mkhan bdag tu 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ lus la mi dang mi ma yin gyis gnod pa byung ba'i dus su nga ni 'dis sdug tu bcug nas 'dug khyed 'di la dga' na da lta khyer/ mgo sogs ya bdud rgyal pos khyer cig /'di la gnod (128)pa skyel ba rnams bka' drin che dgra 'dul rogs pa yin/ 'dre 'dul rogs pa yin pas 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre mi gsum srid du bcad nas 'gong po ci brlag la thod snying tshim 'gal ba med do snyam du srid du gcod/ lus kyi na tsha dang sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs ma mkho ba dang bar chad ci byung yang khyed rang gi bdag tu 'dzin pas lan pa yin pas da dung yang bdag 'dzin ma spangs na bar chad da dung 'byung bas 'jig rten gyi bar chad byung ba byung gis dogs pa thams cad bdag gi steng du da lta nyid du hril gyis smin la bdag ni thul cig brlag tu chug cig snyam du lam du 'jug pa yin/ bzhi pa ni 'di la phan btags pas phan na ci tsam pa'i phan gcig btags/ des 'khor ba las ring du ma song bas 'di brlag tu 'jug dgos pa yin pa la mi mkho ba byung ba de go bcad bla ma'i byin rlabs yin bka' drin che da dung yang mi mkho ba thams cad 'di'i thog tu thod la thul gyis brlag tu chug cig snyam du 'dod thog tu byed pa yin//

theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong*/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'gal rkyen spong ba la gsum ste/ blo sbyong brjed pa'i gnas bzhi/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi gnad gcod bar do dang ma'i mngal dang skye ba phyi ma'o// 'chor ba'i gnas bzhi ni/ mi'i gnod pa drag po byung ba dang*/ mi ma yin ci dang*/ 'byung ba'i na tsha drag po dang*/ nyon mongs pa drag po skyes pa'o// de'i gnyen po bsten pa ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa phul nas bdag gi rgyud la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtogs pa phyin ci ma log par skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ brjed pa'i gnas bzhir mi brjed pa dang*/ 'chor ba'i gnas bzhir mi 'chor bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas chos skyong la gtor ma phul nas kyang de ltar bya'o// rang gis bsod nams bsags nas kyang theg pa chen (129)po'i blo sbyong bdag gi rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /brjed par mi brjed pa dang*/ 'chor ba'i gnas bzhir mi 'chor bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab/ sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams kyis kyang de ltar ro// theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong nyams su len pa'i thag chod bzhi ni lam gcig chod/ 'dun ma gcig dril/ rtog pa 'bur 'joms/ gnyen po bcom rdeg bya ba yin gsung ngo*// lam gcig chod yin te sa lam brtsi rgyu med// bdag 'dzin shas su che che sdug /'di de ring brlag na de ring sangs rgya/ sang brlag na sang sangs rgya/ 'di ma brlag na sangs rgyas med/ 'di brlag na nam brlag tsa na sangs rgyas pa yin gsung ngo*// 'dun ma gcig 'dril yin te 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam ci byed kyang bdag 'dzin ci brlag dang sems can la phan ci thogs las med/ gzhan gyi 'dun ma mang po bya rgyu med gsungs/ rtog pa 'bur 'joms bya ba yin te/ kha cig rtog pa spang zer te/ rtog pa spang mi dgos lam du khyer ba yin chos sku'i rdzas yin te nyon mongs pa 'di dang po chung ngu gcig skye bas de ma thag 'joms dgos pa yin te de ma bcom na cher skyes nas mi spong ste/

dang po nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag tu gnyen po bsten pa tsam gyis ldog pa la a lo o ci byas mi spang gsungs/ rtog pa de skyes na gang nas skyes gnas na gang na gnas/ 'gag na gang du 'gag bltas pas rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa bzhin du rang bzhin med par lam du khyer ba yin gsungs/ yang rdo tshan gyi khar kha ba bab pa bzhin du stong pa nyid du btang ba yin/ gnyen po bcom brdeg bya ba yin te nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag tu gnyen po gang la gang phan (130)gyis phag mgo re la gtun bu cha re'i tshul du bsgom gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong bsgom pa la gnyen po bsten tshul gsum ste/ med sprul/ 'phrad gzhom/ rjes snyags bya gsungs/ dang po ni/ dper na sog po stag 'dul ba ste/ dang po thabs stag byed stag 'dul ba la bslabs pas stag byung ba'i dus su stag thul ba gcig 'ongs/ sngar ma bslab na mi thul bas de'i dbang du 'gro/ de bzhin du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs shas gang che ba de ram ram sprul nas yong ba'i de 'drog la log ste bzlog nas btang*/ blo lung ma bstan du mi 'jog par rang bzhin blo sbyongs pas gnyen po nyon mongs pa skyes pa'i dus su gnyen pos rkyen thub nas 'ongs nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro/ de bzhin du ma bslabs na gnyen pos rkyen mi thub nyon mongs pa'i dbang du bya ba yin gsungs/ 'phrad gzhom bya ba yin te rgan rgon gnyis la rkun ma byung ba bzhin mi bya/ de bzhin tu nyon mongs pa 'di yang dang po nas che ba mi skye/ dang po nas chung ngu gcig skyes ma thag tu khyod su yin byas nas log ste bzlog nas btang na nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro/ gnyen pos rkyen thub nas 'ong*/ de dus su ma bzlog na je che je che la song nas de nas gnyen po rang gis mi thub pas nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag tu phag mgo re la gtun bu cha re'i tshul du log te bzlog nas btang ngo*// rjes snyags bya ba ni nyon mongs pa'i dbang du song ba de'i rjes snyags pa yin te/

a tsam khyod 'dra ba'i 'khos chud gcig 'ong ba de lta bu byed pa'i shag ci yod snyam du rjes snyags pa yin/ gzhan yang nyon mongs pa skyes pa na 'o khyod 'di tsug byas pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ da dung 'di tsug byed dam byas nas log ste bzlog nas btang ba yin gsungs/ sbyor ba la med sprul/ (131)dngos gzhi la 'phrad gzhom/ mjug la rjes snyags bya ba yin gsungs/ blo sbyong gi nad 'don ni spungs pa bskyed pa sbyong ba gsum yin gsungs/ spungs pa ni rang la na tsha byung ba'i dus 'jig rten na na tsha byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig yod pas de thams cad da lta nyid du nga la smin par gyur la sdug bsngal de thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam du bsgom ste/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal rang la spungs pa yin/ bskyed pa ni gang na sar bug pa zang thal gcig bsgom de je che je che la song bas stong pa nyid du cham ste song bar bsgoms la de'i ngang du lhan gyis bzhag pa yin gsungs/ sbyong ba ni gang na ba'i sar a dkar po gcig bsgom/ de je chung je chung la yal te rang bzhin med par song bar bsgoms la de'i ngang du lhan gyis 'jog pa yin gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi gnas kyi dgongs pa bzhi ni/ skyid kyi kha gnon yin/ sdug gi mjug sdud yin/ gcig pur sdod na skyo grogs yin/ na na nad g.yog yin gsungs/ des na chos 'di lta bu gcig med na e na skyid skyid 'dra na mi bya/ rgud na bya 'dod nas 'ongs pas khyod 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa la skyid snyam pa de log shes yin pas de skyes na gang nas skyes/ gnas na gang na gnas/ 'gag na gang nas 'gag /kha dog dang dbyibs ji ltar 'dug bltas pas rang bzhin med par shes pas skyid kyi kha gnon yin/ chos 'di lta bu gcig med na sdug bsngal byung ba dang nga la 'di 'dra ba gcig byung snyam nas sdug bsngal je che la 'gro ba la blo sbyong 'di yod tsa na spyir sdug bsngal thams cad skyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin te/

khyod lus la bdag tu 'dzin pas lan pa yin te sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rkyen (132)tshogs pas lan/ 'ben ma btsug na mda' mi 'phog /tho ma brtsigs na bya mi 'bab/ dpe de bzhin tu bdag tu ma bzung na sdug bsngal yong don med pa la khyod rang gis bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin/ snying tshim/ bdag tu ma bzung na 'di 'dra yong don med sa rdo ri brag nam mkha' stong pa la sdug bsngal yod dam snyam du byas pas sdug bsngal de zhi nas 'gro ste sdug gi mjug sdud yin/ gcig pur sdod na skyo grogs yin te chos 'di lta bu gcig med na gcig pur 'dug mi tshugs te khang par sdod na phyir 'gro snying 'dod/ phyir bsdad na khang par 'gro 'dod nas 'ong ba la chos 'di 'dra ba gcig yod tsa na spyir 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin te rang bzhin grub pa med pa gcig la bdag tu bzung bas sdug bsngal du bcug pa yin pas gang yong gang legs la thong*/ jugs legs la thong snyam du byed/ 'khor ba'i sems can 'di rnams spyir mi yong ba min pha ma drin can sha dag yin pas sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rang gi snying gar len/ rang gi bde dge sems can la bsngo/ de gnyis phar bzlog tshur bzlog tu bsgoms pas 'di'i ro gcig myong tsa na nyin thung mtshan thung la tshab yin pas gcig pur sdod na skyo grogs yin/ na na nad g.yog yin te blo sbyong 'di med na na tsha ji ltar byung tsa na nad g.yog kun la'ang mi mgu/ 'dis nga la 'di bas drag pa gcig byed thong la 'di la nga drin che ba gcig yin te snyams nas yus kyis brgyal nas yong ba yin pa la/ blo sbyong 'di yod tsa na khyod na ba sus kyang ma lan khyed rang gi bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin/ bdag tu ma bzung na na tsha yong don med/ khyod la nad g.yog byas pas phan na de snga phan chad nad g.yog thob par byas pa la tshad med/

sman 'di (133)ma 'gam bya ba med/ rim gro 'di ma byas bya ba med/ dpyad byas pa la lhag ma lus pa med de 'khor ba las thar ma thar da res thul gyis brlag tu chug cig snying tshim mo// bdag 'dzin 'di ci brlag la thong*/ 'di ma brlag na sangs rgyas thob mi srid gsungs/ da khyod rang gi lus bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin snyam du bsgoms pas gzhan la nga rgyal bskyed pa med par 'gro ba yin pas na na nad g.yog byas pa yin gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi khyer so// sdug bsngal byung na kun gyi blang*// dge ba byung na tshogs su bsngo// lus ngag sgyu ma brag cha bzhin// 'od gsal sems la 'gro 'ong med// bya ba gsungs pas/ dang po la gnyis te/ nye rim nas blang ba dang*/ tshe rim nas blang ba'o// dang po ni/ pha ma nye du 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad da lta nyid du bdag la smin par gyur cig /sdug bsngal de thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin par gyur la sdug bsngal de thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ de nas yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin lha dang mi thams cad kyi blang ba'o// dge ba byung na tshogs su bsngo ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byung yang bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di thams cad pha ma gnyis dang rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la smin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ lus ngag sgyu ma brag cha bzhin bya ba lus sgyu ma dang 'dra ste sgyu ma mkhan pos sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pa la brten nas ltad mo ba'i mig la sbyor sngags btab nas sgyu ma sprul pa sna tshogs byed pa gcig snang yang bden par mi 'dzin snang ba nyid kyi (134)ngos na yang grub pa med la rtag chad gnyis dang bral ba snang ba tsam po de mtshon bya'i don rang gi lus 'di la mtshon nas bsgoms pas snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/

ngag brag cha dang 'dra ste brag cha yod pa'i brag de lung pa gcong rong dog po brag cha de las ring ba mkhrigs pa gcig la a rtse brag cha lha mo byas tsa na ci skad bos pa bzhin lan 'debs/ yod byas pas brag chas yod med byas pas med du byung*/ snang ba tsam po de ngag lhang lhang po 'di la mtshan par bsgoms nas brag cha dang khyad par med par bsgom/ snang ba rang bzhin med par bsgom/ 'od gsal sems la 'gro 'ong med bya ba 'od gsal gyi sems la 'dir song bya ba med/ 'dir gnas bya ba med/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa nam mkha' lta bu de ltar lus sgyu ma dang 'dra/ ngag brag cha dang 'dra/ sems rang bzhin grub pa med pas rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du lhun gyis 'jog pa yin gsungs/ dpal mar me mdzad nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa dge legs su gyur cig ༈ /jo bo'i blo sbyong don bdun ma lags so// na mo gu ru/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam gyi mchog /byams dang snying rje stong pa zung 'jug pa// bdag gzhan mnyam nyid bde sdug brje nus pa'i// thugs rje byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// don dam stong nyid bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid// dgra gnyen med par mnyam nyid byang chub sems// gang la skyes na byang chub thob byed pa// dbri bsnan med par bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri// de la 'dir yid ches shing khungs btsun pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ byin rlabs 'jug par bya ba'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ sems can la byams pa bsgom pa dang*/ (135)'phrul 'khor gsum gyi sgo nas snying rje bsgom pa dang*/ smon 'jug gi sems gnyis la ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen lam du bya ba dang*/ dmigs bsal can la phur tshugs su bsgom pa dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ jo bo la bla ma mang du yod kyang 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ḍom+bi pa/

jo bo rje/ 'dzeng dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ pu to ba/ rgya lcags ri ba/ lha ri rtsa brgyad pa/ dwags po lha rje/ phag gru/ rgya sgom ri ba zhig po/ rgya mkhar ri ba/ rin chen brag dmar ba/ zhang brag dkar ba/ bla ma dkon mchog byang chub dpal/ gzhon nu grags/ slob dpon zhang*/ des shes rab bsod nams la/ des brtson 'grus la// des slob dpon chos mchog la/ des slob dpon tshul khrims dpal la/ des bud+dha rat+na la/ des kīr+t+ti shī la la/ des chos rje rgyal ba bzang po la/ des chos rje bsod nams rin chen la/ des gzhon nu rgyal mchog la/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub kyi sems bsgom snyam du sems bskyed pa'i ngang nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma pad zla'i steng du bsgoms la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te chos 'brel yod tshad la phog /tshur 'dus bla ma la thim/ de bzhin brgyud pa'i bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsdus la bla ma la bstim/ de nas lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad bla ma la phul la mos gus dung ba bya/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa tshar ba'i (136)skabs shig de rnams la byams pa bsgom pa gsum ni/ dang po rang gi rtsa ba'i ma mdun du bsams la/ ma 'dis bdag dang phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'gro ba mi'i sa la bzhag pas shin tu drin che ste/ de nas zla ba dgu'am bcur lto na gnas pa'i tshe brtse ba'i bsam pas bskyangs te/ nga'i bu 'di gzhan su dang mi mnyam pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du bu'i ched du mo 'debs/ phywa klog /sā ts+tsha gdab/ chu gtor btang*/ klog 'don la sogs pa byed// sbyor bas kyang bu la gnod pa'i spyod lam thams cad spong*/

btsas nas kyang spu tshogs gcig dang gnyer ma spar gang las med cing se gol gcig bzhag na 'chi ba las skyong ste sha'i drod la rlan mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis kha'i zas bsnyod snabs lces phyis te cung zad cher song ste zas rang gis za shes pa dang pha ma'i ming nas smos te 'bod shes pa dang*/ gog li tsam shes pa la dga' ba byas shing ma rang gi lus pas kyang gces par bzung*/ bu'i ched du skyid sdug gtam gsum la ma ltos par bskyangs/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ cher skyes nas gzhan la bre kha phul kha tsam la ngo nag log log brtsegs nas bsags pa thams cad bu la phongs pa med par byin/ bu'i ched du sdig sdug gtam gsum rang gis blangs rang la nus pa yod na 'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa la 'khor los sgyur ba'i lus la bkod kyang ches snyam pa mi skye/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang du byas na sangs rgyas kyi bde ba la bkod kyang bu la ches snyam pa med par byas/ de ltar brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ snyan pa'i tshig gis bos/ snying gi dum bu phyir lus pa lta bur bskyangs/ rang gis spyad du rung ba'i zas gos nor (137)thams cad bu la phog cing rang bas gces par bzung*/ zhag gcig med kyang blo mi bde bar byas/ phan sna tshogs nas btags gnod pa sna tshogs nas bsal ba'i drin can 'di bdag la de tsam zhig drin che snyam du mig nas mchi ma phyung ba'am lus kyi ba spu ldang pa mang du bsam/ ma 'di la bdag gis ji ltar byas nas phan gdags snyam du bsam/ ma 'di ji ltar byas na bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du mched grogs bza' tshang la bsam/ de nas yul mi khyim mtshes la bsam/ de bzhin du mig gis mthong ba'i sems can thams cad la bsam/ de nas nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi sems can 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la bsgom/ byams pa'i thugs byung na rigs drug re re la ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom du gzhug go

/bdag 'khor ba thog med pa nas da lta'i bar du 'khyams pas sems can gyi ma byas pa yang grangs med la/ mdo myang 'das las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam// ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// ma min pa la yin par bsgom pa min pas sems can thams cad la rtsa ba'i ma bzhin du drin che snyam du ma skyes bar bsgom/ bzhi pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor bcas te snying rje bsgom/ de yang yid kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rigs drug re re la ma skyes bar du bsgom ste/ tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ yang sos/ thig nag /bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med do// de rnams ni dang po rnams la mtshon chas 'tshe ba/ phyi ma dag la ni lcags sreg gi khang pa me 'bar ba sum rim du bcug nas yun dpag tu med par mes bsregs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu (138)med pa yod cing*/ grang dmyal brgyad ni/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol ba can/ a chu zer ba/ so tham pa/ kyi hud zer ba/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa/ pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa ste grang ba'i dmyal ba la sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod pas de rnams kyi tshe tshad dang lus tshad rnams mngon pa dang mdo dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa nas bshad pa bzhin bsams la rang gi rtsa ba'i ma bzhin du ma 'dis sdug bsngal bzod brlag med pa myong na snying re rje snyam du bsam/ ma 'di rnams las ngan bsags pas sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dpag med myong ba snying re rje/ sdug bsngal las ji ltar byas na grol bar 'gyur snyam du bsam zhing mchi ma nyil nyil la bsgom/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni thal mo gnyis 'gram pa la sbyar/ gru mo gnyis brla la btsug lus tsog pur mgo bo bkug /ngo 'dzum bsdus la ngag tu nga'i a ma a ma zhes 'don pa ngag gi 'khrul 'khor ro// de bzhin du yi dwags la yang phyi'i sgrib pa can lo mang po'i bar du zas skom mig gis kyang mi mthong ngo*// mthong yang rnag khrag dang gra phub me 'dags la sogs par song nas bzar mi btub pa'o// nang gi sgrib pa can ni lto ba lung pa'i ltos tsam/

kha khab mig tsam/ mgrin pa 'jag sbubs tsam/ rkang lag 'jag ma tsam du gyur pas zas khar mi shong*/ shong yang mgrin pa nas mi thar lto khengs na rkang lag gis mi theg pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod/ zas skom nyid sgrib par gyur pa ni bza' btung zos pas gra phub me ma mur dang lcags kyi tho lum 'bar ba dang thal bar song nas sdug bsngal ba la dmigs pa sngar bzhin snying rje bsgom/ dud 'gro byings na gnas pa rnams la sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par gsungs la rang gis (139)mthong ba rnams la yang ma shi bar khog par lag pa 'jug pa bya dang gcan gzan gcig gis gcig ma shi bar za ba dang*/ ston ka'i phyugs lug gsod pa dang*/ hor la sogs pas dud 'gro gsod pa dang*/ mi theg bzhin du 'khur dgos pa dang*/ mi 'drud pa bzhin du rmos rmo dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang glen zhing gti mug pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod pas de rnams la dmigs la snying rje sngar bzhin tu bsgom mo// mi la yang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang*/ med pa btsal gyis mi rnyed/ yod pa bsrungs kyis mi thub/ byams pa dang bral ba'i duḥkha/ sdang ba dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ skyid mi ster ba tshig ngan drag 'dul la sogs pa/ med thabs med pa'i bu dang khyo dang chung ma dang grogs dang dpon shi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa dang gzhan yang tshe 'dir sdig pa sha dag spyod pa bzang sems skad cig kyang mi rgyu ba shi ma thag ngan song min pa 'gro sa med pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du sngar bzhin bsgom// lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang*/ bsad shi'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod snyam du bsam/ lha la yang 'chi ltas kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa dang grogs rnams kyis pha rol bor ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ lha 'ga' zhig la tam+bu ra tsam las longs spyod gzhan med pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod pas de rnams la dmigs bsal sngar bzhin snying rje bsgom mo// de rnams kyi tshe tshad lus tshad rnams mngon pa nas bshad pa ltar shes par bya'o// mdor na sems can 'di rnams ma drin can yin pas ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba la spyod pa snying re rje snyam du bsam zhing bdag gi ma 'di rnams kyi shes rab kyi mig long*// (140)thabs kyi rkang pa chag

/bla ma'i long khrid pa dang bral/ grogs bzang po chos la sbyor ba'i 'khar ba dang bral ba 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du mchi ma nyil nyil bsgom mo// lnga pa la/ gnyis las/ dang po smon pa ni/ rang gi lus la na tsha byung ngam mi bde ba ci byung yang de'i dus su bdag gi mi bde ba 'di'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad smin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin nas sems can rnams la sdug bsngal gyi sgra tsam yang mi grag par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ yang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la bde ba dang skyid pa dang dge sbyor 'phel ba dang*/ blo dge phyogs su bskul du btub pa dang*/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi bde ba dang dge ba tsam du bsams la/ bdag gi 'di sems can thams cad la smin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba dang dge ba rgyas par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa 'jug pa ni ma rgan sems can rnams la gang gnod na sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gis gnod pas de rnams kyi lus kyi na tsha dang sems kyi sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa dang sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad spyi gris bzhar ba ltar blos 'ub kyis bsdus la sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung tshur 'ong ba dang bsdong la rang gi snying gi dkyil du zhugs/ mchog tu na tsha dang sdug bsngal gang yang de bzhin du snying gi dkyil du gzhug go /sems can rnams la gcig kyang ma lus par bsam mo// sems can rnams la gang gis phan na gnas skabs su chos kyi mthun rkyen dang mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi bde bas phan pas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la bde ba dang dge ba ci yod pa thams cad gnas skabs su mthun rkyen dang mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi bde ba dpag (141)tu med par bsam/ de rnams rang la gcig kyang ma lus par sna bug g.yas nas rlung phar 'gro ba dang bsdongs nas sems can rnams la smin par bsam/

sems can rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba rgyas par bsam/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje rgyud la skyes nas bsam ngan sdug sems thams cad zhi bar bsam gsung ngo*// drug pa mdor na rang la na tsha dang sdug bsngal blo dang mi mthun pa'i rkyen ma nyes pa'i kha yog dang kha smras dang*/ bdag la 'phyar ka gtong ba dang*/ dgras gtibs pa dang*/ gdon gyi bar chad gtong ba dang*/ cha rkyen ma 'dzom pa dang*/ sems rgyud la nyon mongs pa drag po skyes pa dang*/ blo dge phyogs su bkol tu mi btub pa dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad gus g.yel du song ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang dge sbyor byed snying mi 'dod pa dang*/ blo sna mang pos sems tshol 'phros khyer ba/ snying mi dga' ba/ nga rgyal dang rloms sems skyes pa/ dam tshig nyams chags la sogs pa chos dang mi mthun pa thams cad bdud kyi bar chad yin pas bdud du shes par byas la rig pa la ngar bskyed pa 'di ka'i dus su dgos pa yin snyam du bsams la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dung dung pa mchi ma 'chor ba bsgom/ dgra bgegs gnod par byed pa la lhag par bsgom/ de nas sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad kyi bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rang la gang byung ba de'i steng du shugs bskyed la blangs la/ de nas blangs pa'i yul dang sdug bsngal dang blang rgyu'i dngos po thams cad kyang rang sems 'khrul pa'i rang snang du thag bcad la sems skye (142)'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ngang la klod la bzhag go /dar bskyar zhing yang yang bsgoms pas bdud kyi bar chad dang sdug bsngal thams cad dag spor gyi bogs 'don du 'gro zhing bar chad thams cad bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlabs su shes shing blo nges pa'i shes pa gting nas skye gsung ngo*// de ltar byung na ltas ngan g.yang du len/

bdud chos nyid du go /rkyen ngan grogs su shar nas snang ba gang shar thams cad lam du 'gro ba gcig 'ong gsung ngo*// de ltar byung yang rloms sems mi bya/ byas na bdud yin/ yang rang gi dge ba dang lus sems kyi dge ba thams cad snga ma ltar shes par bya'o// de ltar snang ba thams cad rang sems su thag bcad la dus rtag tu dran pas zin par bya'o// bdun pa dmigs bsal can la phur tshugs su bsgom pa ni rang la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs sam sdang ba'i dgra la sogs pa la bsgom ste/ de yang rang la sngar nas kha zug pa'i gdon dang*/ glo bur du gnod pa'i gdon gang yang rung ste/ gdon de rmi lam la sogs par kho'i gzugs nang cho 'phrul gang ston brtags la de ngos bzung ngo*// dgra'am gdon de rang gi mdun du bkug la gsal bar bsgoms la/ gzhan yang sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'byung po'i rigs thams cad kyang bsam/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang bsams la gnod byed kyis gtsor byas pa'i sems can rnams bdag gi ma drin can yin/ 'di rnams tshe snga ma mang por pha ma yang yang du byas pas lan chags 'ong ba yin/ ma drin can 'dis las ngan pa bsags pas lus 'di 'dra blangs/ lus 'di 'dra ba la brten nas nga med pa la ngar bzung*/ bdag med pa la bdag tu bzung*/ da lta sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba sha stag byas pas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal chen po las thar dus med pa (143)snying re rje snyam du bsam/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma lta bur bsam zhing nga'i a ma zhes ngag tu yang brjod cing snying rje drag po mig nas mchi ma nyil nyil ba'am lus kyi ba spu ldang ba tsam bsgoms la/ khos gtso byas pa'i sems can rnams lus kyi na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad rang gi sems mi bde ba gang yod pa de'i steng du 'ubs kyis bsdus la rang gi de dag gnyis med du bsdus la kho la gcig kyang ma lus par bsam mo// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad kho la btang bas kho'i bsam ngan dang gdug sems thams cad zhi nas byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar bsam/

de yang yang bya'o// yang nad gdon thams cad bka' drin can tu bsgom/ dge sbyor gyi bskul ma byas pas drin che bas dus 'di nas bzung nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mi 'bral bar bya snyam du bsam/ gzhan yang lus sems kyi steng du sdug bsngal mi 'tshams pa byung ba'i tshe yid ma shi bar byas/ rig pa ngar bskyed la 'di ka'i dus su dgos pa yin snyam pa byas la/ gnod byed kyis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dngos rgyu dang bcas pa rnams bsam/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma lta bu drin che ba 'di rnams sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba spyod pa snying re rje na bdag la ni da lta sdug bsngal las grol bar byed pa'i nus pa med na ma 'di rnams ji ltar byas na sdug bsngal las grol bar 'gyur snyam du sems kyi 'phrul 'khor sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsam/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni lus tsog pur 'dug la lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mos 'gram pa skyor/ gru mo brla yi steng du bzhag bzhin gyi mdog smin mtshams su bsdus la mchi ma 'don pa'i tshul du bya'o// ngag gi 'khrul 'khor ni nga'i a ma zhes brgya dang stong la sogs pa bgrang ngo*// de (144)ltar byams pa bsgoms pas snying rje dbang med du skye ba 'byung ngo*// du snying 'dod pa dang*/ snying grang ba dang sdug bsngal can mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dran pa tsam gyis snying rje rang dbang med du skye ba 'byung ngo*// de ltar byung ba dang sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad skra gris bzhar ba bzhin du sna bug g.yon nas rlung nang du 'ong ba dang bsdongs nas rang gi snying nang du zhugs sems can la sdug bsngal gcig kyang ma lus par bsam/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa gang skyes kyang de ltar yang yang bya'o// yang dag pa'i don la 'di yin 'di min med pa'i lta ba'i steng du bzhag /rang gi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad ltos pa med par sems can la phar btang bas sems can thams cad kyi gnod sems gdug rtsub thams cad zhi bar bsam mo// de ltar byas pas nad gdon thams cad grogs su 'char ro// phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab bo// gnas skabs su nad gdon thams cad rang grol du 'gro ba'i shes byed mang du yod de 'dir ma bris so// bya ba gang byed kyang 'dis zin na sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro gsungs/

'di dang mi ldan na gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas pa byas kyang mu stegs kyi drag sngags bzlas pa dang khyad med du 'gro gsung ngo*// gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams su legs par blta'o/// /mchims kyi blo sbyong lags so// bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa 'di la don gsum ste/ dang po sbyong ba ni/ gnas dben par tshangs spyod mi mthun pa'i phyogs med pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed byas la rang gi lus phrum phus btab pa lta bur bden med du bsam/ snying 'od dkar po'i phung por bsgom/ de'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma (145)bsgom/ sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar gyi brgyud pa dang chos 'brel yod pa dang yi dam gyi lha dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bo 'di yin snyam du bsam/ yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyis bdag gi rgyud la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtogs pa nyams pa med par skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa da lta nyid du thul ba dang*/ rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad chos kyi phyogs su khyer shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bdag gi bla ma 'di nyes pa'i skyon bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad spangs shing legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas yin snyan du bsams la bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas bla ma tshangs bug na mar byon nas snying 'od kyi phung po'i nang du bzhugs nas 'di nyid sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam du bsgom mo// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas chos nyid 'od gsal chen por gyur pa de'i ngang du gnas tshad du bzhag
