/de nas rtog pa 'phro na bla ma spyi gtsug tu bsgom/ thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsngo ba bya/ gsol ba gdab/ de lta bu nyin mtshan lan drug la sogs pa bya/ rang gang 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye'o// dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ ces pa ni de la gsum ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba ni dal 'byor gyi chos bsam ste de'i snying po blang bar bya/ chos kyi mchog blo sbyong ba yin pas bsgom/ dal 'byor thob kyang gtan du sdod (146)dbang med/ las kyi 'phen pa zad nas nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba'i dus su chos rgyud la ma skyes par 'gyod bzhin du shi na de las pham pa med pas blo sbyong dgos sam shi nas med par mi 'gro/ skye ba len dgos la 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas de spang bar bya/ de'i ched du blo sbyong bsgom/ rang rgyud la bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyang*/ gzhan la'ang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom mo// dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang*// len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsams// zhes pa ni/ bdag la skye ba phyi ma'i phyi ma phan chad dang tha na sang phan chad smin rgyu'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung thams cad da lta smin par gyur cig ces snyam du bsam/ de bsam pas rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ de nas rtsa ba'i ma la byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms la sdug bsngal kun 'byung thams cad zhe thag pa nas blang*/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi dang 'phags pa gsum gyi shes sgrib thams cad blang*/ mdor na bla ma dang sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa'i 'khor 'das kyi skyon thams cad rang gi snying gi nang du blang*/ de ltar yang yang blangs pas ro stod gzer ba la sogs pa byung na snying phru ma bus pa lta bur bsams te/ de yang rgya cher song bas nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par bsam ste rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la bzhag go

/de stong nyid bsgom pa'o// bdag gi ma 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi dngos rgyu la gnas pas snying rje/ sdug bsngal dngos rgyu mtha' dag las bsgral te bde ba skyid pa bla na med pa la 'god/ nga'i ched du lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gtong snyam du bsams la/ lus yid bzhin gyi (147)nor bu rin po cher bsgyur/ longs spyod lha dang mi'i rdzas nam mkha' gang ba tsam pa dge ba dus gsum du bsags pa thams cad ma rgan la btang bas chos byed pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad tshang ba dang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang sangs rgyas par bsgom/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad la bsgom// de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya// zhes pa ni dbugs phyir 'gro dus longs spyod dge ba thams cad sems can la btang*/ de ltar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ nang du 'ong tsa na rang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun 'byung len/ de ltar byas pas rgyud la skye ba dang*/ blo sbyong skye ba'i dgos pa yod gsung ngo*// gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni// sbyangs nas gsang ba'i don la spyad// ces pa ni bdag gi dge ba dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal ba brje nus pa dang*/ blo dman pa la gsang ba'i stong nyid bsgoms te de yang dngos po thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dus te gzung ba thams cad yul/ yul bem por snang ba thams cad rim gyis dpyad pas rdul phra rab yin la de yang phyogs drug la blta ba'i cha drug dbus sha stags su gyur nas bden pa gcig tu ma grub pas de ma grub/ de dag gis du ma mi grub pas bem po bden pa med par bsgom// nang rig pa ni 'das pa 'gag ma 'ongs pa ma skyes da ltar kha dog med dbyibs med gnas med/ de ltar ma grub tsa na bden par ma grub pas na rang rig pa bden pa med par bsam/ phyi bem po ma grub pas bsgom bya'i yul ma grub/ nang rig pa snang ba ma grub pas sgom byed kyi blo ma grub/

bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba de la shes bya zad pa zhes zer/ de yi ngang la ma yengs par gnas pa la de kho na nyid bsgom zhes gsungs/ de bas na yul ci yang ma grub pa la blos (148)cir yang mi 'dzin// cir yang mi rtog pa'i ngang la lhod de klod la bzhag /'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni// klong na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsungs/ rtog pa'i 'phro 'du thams cad zhi ba ni zhi gnas/ mi rtog bzhin du gsal zhing dwangs pa la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa ni lhag mthong zhes gsungs so// dang po thun chung la grangs mang por bsgom/ brtan pa thob na ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bzhag /de las ldang bar 'dod na sems can la snying rje bsgom zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// dang po'i dus su kun rdzob don dam gnyis la res 'jog tu bsgom/ goms par gyur nas thams cad ma grub kyang kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bden pa dang zhen pa med par gtong len bsgom par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ yul gsum dug gsum zhes pas yul gsum la brten nas dug gsum skye zhing de dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum du bsgyur te mig gi yul du gzugs sdug pa la 'dod chags skyes pa dang*/ sems can gyi 'dod chags rang gi snying gi dkyil du blang rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa sems can thams cad la btang bas sems can thams cad 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par bsam/ mi sdug pa la zhe sdang dang bral la gti mug skyes pa yang de bzhin tu bsgom/ de bzhin tu rna bas sgra dang*/ snas dri dang*/ lces ro dang*/ lus kyi reg bya'i bar du gsum gsum byung yang bsgom par bya'o// spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyong*// zhes pa ni 'gro ba dang 'greng ba dang 'dug pa dang nyal ba dang spyod lam thams cad du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal kun 'byung thams cad da lta nyid du bdag la smin par gyur cig

/bdag phung bar gyur cig /bdag dngos po med pa'i gtan brlag la 'gro bar gyur cig /bdag gi lus longs spyod dang dge (149)ba thams cad sems can rnams la phan par gyur cig /lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad da lta nyid du 'byung bar gyur cig ces sogs kyang sbyang bar bya'o// de ltar sbyong bas ngag gi rjes su yid zhugs nas myur du skye ba'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ blo sbyong thun gcig zhes bya ba dpal snar thang pa'i mkhan po mchims nam mkha' grags chen pos mdzad pa dge legs nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig/ ༈ //rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la jo bos gnang ba'i blo sbyong lags so// shes bya'i mkha' la tshad yod ma mchis kyang*// stong dang snying rje gnyis su len pa yin// mar me mdzad dpal la sogs bla ma la// sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis gus phyag 'tshal// 'gro mgon bod du byon khar gdams pa ni// brtse bar gyur pa'i nor bu bdag la gnang*// nam mkha' 'di la rgyu rkyen ma mchis bu// yod par su 'dzin med par su zhig 'dzin// chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyis shig bu// 'di la gol na gol sa shin tu mang*// nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par zhog gcig pu// 'on kyang mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa na// yod yod lta bur mdzes shing 'char ro bu// 'di la rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma mthong*// 'on kyang rten 'brel legs mchis mkhas pa'i bu// 'ja' tshon mkha' la rgyu zhing mkha' la yal// 'di la rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma mthong*// 'di yang rten 'brel lags mchis mkhas pa'i bu// legs par brtags na 'ja' tshon nam mkha' ru// tha dad rnam dbye 'dug gam mkhas pa'i bu// ye nas stong pa chos kyi gnas lugs la// 'gro la bzod blag med pa'i snying rje 'khrigs// snying rje byung yang chos kyi dbyings nas byung*// thim yang (150)chos kyi dbyings su thim mo bu// 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems nyid de// de la rgyu rkyen yod pa sus ma mthong*// brtags shing dpyad na nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin gda'// des na nam mkha' 'ja' tshon ji lta bur// stong nyid snying rje shes par mdzod cig bu// gang yang rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' zab pa las// steng nas g.yo ba'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa mthong*// rba rlabs byung yang rgya mtsho nyid las byung*// thim yang rgya mtsho nyid la thim mo bu// g.yo ba'i rlabs dang zab pa'i rgya mtsho la// tha dad rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong*// de bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i stong nyid las// 'gro la g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa'i snying rje byung*// snying rje byung yang stong nyid ngang las byung*// thim yang stong pa nyid la thim mo bu// me long g.ya' yis dag pa'i da la la// sna tshogs gzugs brnyan bkra bzhin shar ba de// me long nyid dam phyi rol gzugs las byung*// de las gzhan nam 'on te rgyu med pa// gang du'ang dpyad na 'jig rten rten 'brel tsam// byad gzhan yod ma myong dang snang ba gnyis// tha dad rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong*// de bzhin stong nyid me long lta bu la// yod ma myong ste gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar// stong dang snying rje brten cig mkhas pa'i bu// rnyog med chab kyi da la ngangs pa la// chu shel zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar na yang*// gnyis snang lta bur rang nyid 'khrul mod kyi// grub pa'i rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong*// rnyog med nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid las// 'gro la bzod blag med pa'i snying rje shar// snying rje byung yang stong nyid ngang las byung*// thim yang stong nyid ngang du thim mo bu// ji ltar gzugs kyi brag ri mthon po la// lhang lhang 'chor ba'i sgra snyan byung na yang*// sgra snyan brag las rnam (151)dbye su zhig yod// 'on kyang brag med yod med su zhig 'dzin// de bzhin ye nas dag pa'i stong nyid las// 'gro la shin tu brtse ba'i sgra 'byung mod// stong nyid snying rje de bzhin sgoms shig bu// rnyog med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dwangs pa la// 'gro la dngos su phan pa'i 'od 'byung mod// nyi 'od tha dad nyid du sus ma mthong*// stong nyid snying rje chen po'i gzugs su shar// snying rje de yang stong pa 'ba' zhig ste// stong pa nyid las snying rje gzhan yod par// mgon po gang gis ma bshad mkhas pa'i bu// kye ho stong nyid ngang du tshur nyon cig

/'gro ba thams cad nyon mongs sdug bsngal spangs// stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin gyi shes par mdzod// de yi gnyen po yon tan mtha' yas kyang*// stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin gyi goms par mdzod// spang gnyen tha dad lta bur mthong na yang*// 'khrul 'khor dag par bsam gtan lam du bsgom// de ltar ma go 'gro ba mtha' yas pa// rang la bsdus kyang spang dgos cang gda' 'am// stong nyid snying rjer ltos dang cang 'khrul lam// snying rje stong par 'dug gam mkhas pa'i bu// stong pa snying rjer shar ram rtog dpyod can// stong dang snying rje rnam dbyer 'dug gam a// kho bos zhe sdang rlung dmar 'tshub na yang*// stong pa nyid la tha dad med par mthong*// de bzhin rnam par rtog pa mtha' yas pas// stong nyid ngang las nges par 'byung ba mthong*// rnam rtog rnams la cer te bltas tsam na// bden nam brdzun nam grub par ngas ma mthong*// stong nyid ngang las lhod kyis klod tsam na// rtog pa tsam yang 'char bar ngas ma mthong*// des na stong nyid snying rje 'gal zla yang*// dbye ba rdul tsam yod par ma mthong gi /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med smos ci 'tshal// kye ho da ni 'gro'am 'dug na yang*// (152)gnas de dgon pa yin no mkhas pa'i bu// dbu ma'i nang du sems nyid gnas pa de// stong pa'i gnas lugs yin no mkhas pa'i bu// de yi ngang du snying rje bsgom pa de// dbye ba med pa'i rnal 'byor yin no bu// de ltar shes pa'i snying rje bsgom pa na// shin tu brtse yang stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin// stong nyid bsgoms pas snying rjes ma khyab med// snying rje sgom pa stong nyid kho na yin// stong pa tsam zhig zhi gnas tshel ba'ang sgom// theg pa 'di yi stong nyid snying rje yin// snying rje 'di yi rang mtshan stong nyid yin// des na gnas don snying rjer shes par mdzod// khyod la bya ba'i rim pa mtha' yas kyang*// brgya phrag ngos kyi bcar phur chen po 'di// tshe 'di'i nyan bshad snying gtam tha mar bsten// da ni kho bo mi sdod bod du 'gro

/'phreng sems dag kyang rdza dang la cha 'dra// tshe 'di'i 'du byed mi rtag glog ltar g.yo// lus sems 'du ba'ang mgron khang mgron po 'dra// des de phyogs 'dir ldog pa srid pa bas// 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba 'dus byas chos// gdams ngag sems la 'chang na bu yin ang*// bslab pa'i ngag la nyan na yun du dge /ring por mi thogs byams pa'i zhabs drung du// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshig don rnams// yongs su rdzogs par bya phyir dga' ldan 'gro/ khyod kyang skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu// de drung snyogs nas gsung gleng byed par smon// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa// bdag cag rnams la brtse bar dgongs su gsol// dus gsum 'khor tshe skye gnas thams cad du// sgo gsum dge ba'i las la bkol ba rnams// sku gsum phrin las rdzogs par ma gyur bar// gang gi lus su skye ba 'dzin na yang*// pha rol phyin bcur sgo gsum 'khol ba dang*// bla ma (153)mnyes shing phrin las spel bar shog /ces pa 'di 'gro ba'i mgon po bod du 'byon dus lam du 'jug pa na rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu bdag la spyi chos su gdams pa lags so// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo nas mkhan po rma ston gyi bar sngar bzhin/ des jo ldan klung shod pa la/ des dge bshes shes rab bzang po// des bud+dha rat+na la/ des kīrti shī la la/ des chos rje rgyal ba bzang po la/ des chos rje bsod nams rin chen la/ des chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mchog la'o/ ༈ /dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i blo sbyong*/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i zhal nas// thog med brtse bas bskyangs pa yi// drin chen rnams la snying rje bsam// gnod byed 'di ni bdag gi ma// sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang*// smyon pa lta bur rang dbang med// mi dge las kyis mnar med 'gyur// de ltar dran pas srid gsum la// snying rje mthar phyin 'gyur ba yin// gsung*// de la mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor ni// snying rje de theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin/

'di med na pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa dang dam tshig gi bskyed rdzogs la sogs lam ci tsam yod kyang theg pa dman par ltung ste// byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems dgos pas byams pa ni phan 'dogs pa yin la/ snying rje ni gnod byed nas thog drang nas bsgom ste/ gnas dben par lus kyi spyod lam cha mnyam skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rang yi dam du bsam/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ rang gzhan la gnod pa tshab cher byed pa'i dgra bo lta bu gcig mdun du dmigs la snying rje'i rgyun dang 'thad pa gnyis spel mar bsgom/ dang po lus bsgrim/ sems rtse gcig tu (154)gnod byed la dmigs la ngag tu bdag la gnod par byed pa 'di snying re rje brgya'am lnga bcu'am nyer gcig bgrang ba ni rgyun du bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa 'thad pa ni/ gnod byed 'di skye ba snga ma phan chad kyi ma yin pas ma 'di snying re rje snyam du bsam yang yang bgrang*/ ci'i phyir snying rje nam yang lan gcig gnyis byas pa ma yin te/ lan grangs mang por byas pas snying re rje snyam du bsam yang yang bgrang*/ ci'i phyir snying rje na ma byas res kyis phan dpag tu med pa btags pas snying rje snyam du bsam yang yang bgrang cis snying rje na spyir ma ni phan 'dogs pa yin na da lta gnod pa byed pa ji ltar yin na gnod byed 'di ma yin yang shes pa la rang dbang ma thob pas smyon pa dang 'dra/ spyir sems can la khyad par du rang gi bu la gnod pa byed pa snying re rje snyam du bsam yang yang bgrang*/ cis snying rje na de ltar gnod pa byas pa'i rgyus mnar med pa la sogs par skyes nas sdug bsngal drag pos gzir bar 'gyur bas gnod byed kyi ma 'di snying re rje snyam du bsam yang yang bgrang*/ de ltar dmigs pa dang*/ bgrang ba dang*/ snying rje ba'i rgyu bsam pa lnga spel mar bsam pas mig nas mchi ma 'byung ba dang*/ lus kyi ba spu ldang ba'am/

lus sems kyi zung mi thub pa sogs rtags kyis mtshon pa'i snying rje ci lta ba bzhin skyes nas gnod byed 'dis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du sems la gnod byed dang sems can thams cad kyis yi dam gyi go 'phang thob par bsams la/ spros med kyi ye shes la yun ring du bzhag /rnam rtog sbun langs na bsngo ba bya'o// de ltar gcig la ji lta ba bzhin skyes nas gnod byed bar ma dang chung ngu rnams la yang bsam// de nas nye 'brel yul mi sde 'dzam bu gling*/ gling bzhi (155)stong gsum nam mkhas khyab pa bsgoms pas snying rje tshad med par 'gyur ro// de ltar bsgoms pas rang gi zhe sdang khong khro la sogs zhi// mdze nad gdon la sogs pa dgra bgegs zhi la 'gro ba sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i sems su 'gyur ro// spros med kyi ye shes khyad par can skye'o// gnyis pa rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor ni// phyi nang spros pa mi srun pas// blo gros 'khrugs par gyur pa'i tshe// bdag dang gzhan du brje ba yi// byang chub sems 'di dran par bya// des ni bdud dang nyon mongs tshogs// 'joms shing spros med ye shes 'gyur// ces gsungs pas rnam mkhyen thob pa'i rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems yin pas de la kun rdzob dang don dam byang chub kyi sems gnyis las/ don dam ni spros med kyi ye shes yin no// dang po la mang du yod kyang 'dir bdag gzhan brje ba'i nyams len bla mas gsungs pa ni lus la nad drag po dang sems la mya ngan gnyis ka la sdug bsngal dang*/ dgra gdon phyi'i 'byung ba 'khrugs pa nyon mongs pa drag po la sogs pa skyes pa'i dus su de nyid lam du bya ba'i phyir zhe sdang drag po skyes na bdag gi zhe sdang 'dis sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa nga'i 'di la smin par gyur cig

/yang sems can gyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyis bskyed pa thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig /bye brag tu dmyal ba'i btso bsreg sogs/ yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro'i gsod bkol/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs/ mi la skye rga na 'chi la sogs/ nad pa rnams kyi nad/ dbul po rnams kyi dbul phongs pa/ dbang po ma tshang ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal (156)ba thams cad bdag gi 'di la smin par gyur cig /dal 'byor nas sa dang lam gyi gegs thams cad dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nga'i zhe sdang 'di la smin par gyur cig ces lus ngag yid gsum sgrims la rtse gcig tu sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rang la bsdus shing len/ de ltar chu tshod gcig gam gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa'i bar du rtse gcig tu bsgom/ ji srid nyon mongs pa'am rnam rtog de ma zhi bar du bsam/ nad kyi zug rngu ma zhi bar du lam du bya'o// sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// ces ngag tu brjod do// de nas rang gi tshogs gnyis kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dge ba ji snyed thams cad snying ga nas nyi ma shar ba'i 'od zer ltar 'phros te sems can la phog pas sems can thams cad sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin yi dam lha'i ngo bo la bkod par bsam mo// de nas spros med kyi ye shes kyi ngang la bzhag pas ye shes khyad par can 'char ro// rnam rtog spun langs na dge ba bsngo'o// las dang po pas de ltar nyams su blang ngo*// goms nas rnam rtog phra rags 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal la sogs gang byung yang snga ma ltar gcig tu dril la rtse gcig tu bya/ ngag tu/ bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces brjod do// bdag gi lus longs spyod dag pa rnams sems can la smin nas zag med kyi bde ba thob par bsam dmigs pa'i dal myur yin don la khyad med gsung ngo*// rjes sngar dang 'dra'o// kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la gnas skabs rnam rtog nyon mongs zhi/

nad gdon las grol/ skye 'gro thams cad la phan thogs dbang du 'gyur/ mthar thug longs sku sprul sku'i sa thob nas ma 'ongs pa na gzhan don phun sum tshogs par 'grub bo// don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis chos sku'i sa bon (157)theb ste phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ de lta bu'i rten 'brel 'dzom na rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la rtags ci rigs su 'byung ngo*// khyad par du shes pa gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan mas stong pa zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rgyud la 'char ro// de ka la rang rig pa'i ye shes skad cig ma zhes bya ba skad cig ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gnas te sems stong pa mi rtog pa chos sku rang rig pa longs sku gsal ba de sprul sku de gsum ngo bo dbyer med pa de ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// shes pa de nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral bas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de nyid rang stong par rtogs pas me long lta bu/ rang rig pa so sor rtog pa/ rang gsal ba bya bar grub pa'i ye shes/ de dbyer med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i dgongs pa rje btsun dar paṇa ār+ya'i gsung*/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig mnyam med snying rje'i man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bir+wa pa/ rje btsun ḍom+bhi pa/ rje btsun ma ti ma/ grub thob ṇi ka la pa/ rje btsun ra ben+d+ra ba/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ bla ma dam pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ma ti shrī/ bla ma ye shes zhabs bzang po'i dpal/ des bud+dha rat+na la/ des kīrti shī la la/ des dza ya bha dra la/ des puṇ+ye ra tu la/ des gzhon nu rgyal mchog la/ des bdag la'o// de las byung ba'i dge ba rnam dag des// 'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la// stong nyid snying rje lhag bsam rnam dag gis// zag med bde la myur du bkod par shog /maṅga la bha ban+tu/ shu bhaṃ// ༈ //blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma lo rgyus dang bcas pa bzhugs/

bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dge bshes 'chad ka ba'i zhal nas/ bdag bka' gdams pa rnams la dad pa (158)'di dang po slob dpon lcags zhing pa las tshig rkang brgyad pa 'di thos nas/ de nas klungs shod dge gong bar du 'di'i rtsad gdar bcad nas tshig rnams la bsngo bgrang bag re byas pa las rgyud la skyes pa ni mi bdog /skyes na 'di min gcig 'ong ba la gsungs/ dang po ni/ 'gro 'ong byed tsa na dgra byung gis dogs pa la 'di dran pas phan par byung*/ blo rgod du thal bas mi la gnas khang gnya' ba sha stags dgos par bsad tsa na gnas gsha' ma ma rnyed pa dang gzhan gyis brnyas pa byed pa byung ba la sogs pa ma btub pa thams cad la 'dis phan par byung gsungs/ de nyid gang yin tshig rkang brgyad po 'di dag yin// bdag ni sems can thams cad la// yid bzhin nor bas lhag pa yin// don mchog bsgrub pa'i bsam pa yis// mchog tu gces par 'dzin par bslab// de la spyir sems can thams cad la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher bslab pa ni sems can dang rin po che gnyis 'dra chos gnyis yod// rin po che 'dam gyi gseb tu bcug na kho rang gis 'dam yang 'byin mi nus la chos bco lnga la dri bzang pos khrus byas/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags nas mchod pa phul na 'dzam bu gling pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ltar sems can 'khor ba na nyes pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa yang rang gis rang 'khor ba nas 'don mi nus shing sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung sel mi nus kyang*/ de la phan btags na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dge ba thams cad 'byung ste gnas skabs kyi bde ba yang sems can med na gang nas tshol te rang 'gags la/ mthar thug gi bde ba byang chub gsum yang sems can la brten nas 'byung ste/ de nyid sems can la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bla na med pa thob par 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa khyad par (159)du/

gang du su dang 'grogs pa'i tshe// bdag la kun nas dman lta zhing*// gzhan la bsam pa thag pa yi// mchog tu 'dzin pa dag tu bslab// ces pa ltar gnas gang du sdod rung grogs su dang 'grogs rung phyogs thams cad du rang la dman par btags la snying thag pa nas gzhan la gus par bya ba bslab pa ni grogs rang la mtho ba bla ma dang rang dang mnyam pa tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ dma' mo sprang la sogs pa'o// phyogs thams cad ni rigs dang bsam pa'i mthu dang skyon gyi ngos nas rang la dman par btags nas bdag rigs la nga rgyal byar mi rung*/ dus thams cad rigs ngan shan pa'i rigs yin pa la nga rgyal cis byed/ gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas lta bu'i 'os su yang mi 'dug /bsod nams mthu las dbang thang de thams cad kyang mi 'dug cing*/ shes rab la nga rgyal byed na rig pa'i gnas lnga las phyogs gcig kyang mi shes la bag re nyan pa kun la yang tshig don lhag chad byung yang ngo ma shes par 'dug /spyod pa 'phral gyi bya ba la bdag dge sbyor du khas 'chi yang bya ba ngan pa ma byas pa tsam yang mi 'dug la da lta yang bsam pa dug gsum du skye zhing lus ngag gi bya ba phal che ba ma dag par grub pas phyi ma myang 'das las mngon mtho rang yang thob pa dka' ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni// mi yi lus kyang thob mi 'gyur// mi lus thob par ma gyur na// sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med// ces pas rang gi skyon mtha' dag bsams la/ bdag gi 'og nas 'gro ba chu 'di las med snyam du nga rgyal bcag la gzhan la gus par bya ba la bslab ces pa ni gzhan gyi yon tan dngos su mthong ba/ rigs dang gzugs dang longs spyod dang chos kyi yon tan pha rol phyin pa drug la sogs pa gang mthong ba la skyon gyi rang bzhin 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa ngo mtshar che snyam du bsam mo// yang yon tan dngos su mi 'dug pa la 'di kun la nang na yon tan ci yod mi shes snyam du bsam ste a tsa ra (160)gzugs ngan gyi gtam rgyud gsungs so// snying thag pa rus pa'i gting nas zhes pa ni bsam pa de yang kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par thams cad la gyong khengs med par gnyen lcug gtong dgos bsam pa de yod na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis kyang rigs kyi bu legs so zhes gsungs pa yin/

de'i 'thad pa ni rgya mtsho de gzhol bas chu thams cad der 'bab pa bzhin nga rgyal med pa'i rgyud la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad skye ba yin pas/ sdud par/ 'gro ba kun la bran gyur bzhin tu gnas par bya/ gsungs te/ sde snod gsum gyi don yang nga rgyal de gcog pa'i thabs yin/ nga rgyal de yod na tshe 'dir yang su dang mi mthun pa gcig 'ongs la phyi ma'i nyes pa yong*/ rmongs pa gang zhig nga rgyal dbang gis ni// ngan song pa dang mi khom gnas su skye// dbul dang dman pa'i rigs su skye ba dang*// dmus long mthu chung mdog ngan 'dzin par byed// ces nyon mongs pa'i bag chags je 'thug pa song ste// yul dman pa thams cad la nyon mongs pa drag po skye la/ de las lci zhing mthar thug gi byang chub kyang mi thob ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nga rgyal can// byang chub la ni de nyid ring*// zhes so// des na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i smad pa dang rgud pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag bzang por 'dzin pa las byung la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad sems can las byung bas sems can thams cad yon tan can du bltas la nga rgyal bcag par bya'o// gsum pa ni da ltar byed du nyon mongs pas mi ster bas de yang spang ba ni// spyod lam kun tu rang rgyud la// brtag cing nyon mongs skyes ma thag /bdag gzhan ma rungs byed pas na// btsan thabs gdong nas bzlog par bslab// ces pa spyod (161)lam thams cad du rang gi rgyud la brtags la nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag btsan thabs su bzlog pa la bslab pa ni spyod lam bzhi po gang byed kyang rang gi rgyud la 'dod pa'i rnam rtog la sogs skye mi skye dran shes bzhin gyis bdag la skyes ma thag spang gi an cig nas yang spang snyams na brtas nas 'gro bas 'bur 'joms bya ste bza' tsho gnyis la rkun ma byung ba bzhin byas na phyis long can du song na ye mi spang ba yin/

nyon mongs pa rgyud la 'phel na zhe sdang la sogs pa thams cad je 'phel du 'gro ste/ mdo las// de bzhin nyid la dag pa dang*// phyir bzhin de bzhin gnyid cher 'gyur// de bzhin 'dod chags che ba dang*// chags la sred pa'ang de bzhin 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags cher song ste yul dman pa thams cad la nyon mongs drag po skye la/ de las lci zhing sdug bsngal chen po yang nyams su myong dgos// nyon mongs pa spangs na bag chags je srab la 'gro ste/ sngar gyi bag chags kyang zhir 'gro la/ yul bzang po la bag chags phra mo las mi skye/ de'i las 'bras phra bas myong ba nges par 'gro ba yin la/ nyon mongs pa la dgrar blta ba la gnyen po stobs bskyed/ zhi ba lhas/ bdag ni bsregs te bsad gyur tam// de bzhin mgo bo bcad kyang rung*// rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs pa'i// dgra la 'dud par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs la/ 'jig rten pa'i dgra bos lo ka las gnod pa mi byed la nyon mongs pas tshe rabs thams cad du gnod pa byed de// bdag gi nyon mongs dgra bo gang*// dus ring thog mtha' med pa ltar// dgra gzhan kun kyang de lta bur// yun ring thub pa ma yin no// zhes so// yang 'jig rten gyi dgra la phyogs (162)su phul na mi gnod par phan 'dogs la nyon mongs la de ltar phul na thu ru 'gro ste/ mthun par rim gros brten byas na// thams cad bde dang phan byed de// nyon mongs dgra ni bsten byas nas// phyir zhing sdug bsngal gnod par byed// ces so// yang 'jig rten pa'i dgras lus srog longs spyod la gnod pa tsam las mi byed la nyon mongs pas 'khor bar sdug bsngal dpag tu med par skyed par byed de// gal te lha dang lha min rnams// thams cad bdag la dgrar langs kyang*// de dag gis kyang mnar med pa'i// me nang khrid cing 'jug mi nus// nyon mongs stobs ldan dgra 'dis ni// gang dang 'phrad na ri rab kyang*// thal ba tsam yang mi lus pa// der bdag skad cig gcig la 'dor// zhes so// de ltar nyon mongs pa de la dgrar bltas la dor/

'jig rten gyi dgra yul 'thon yang phyis gnod pa byed du 'ongs te/ nyon mongs pa 'di spangs na phyis skye mi nus la sa bon tshig pa dang 'dra ba yin no// spang lugs spyod pa dang bsgom pa dang lta bas spangs te/ de yang las dang po pa gnyen po stobs chung bas nyon mongs pa skye na bzlog dka' bas spyod lam gyis spang*/ sgom pa ni nyon mongs pa re la gnyen po re gsungs/ skyes bu gsum gang sgom pa des nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro bas de bsgom pas chog /blo yang chod song na nyon mongs pa la yul med pas de ngo shes pas chog gi spang rgyu med de/ nyon mongs shes rab mig gis spangs// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ shin tu rang bzhin ngan pa dang sdig pa dang sdug bsngal drag pos non pa rnams la shin tu rnyed par dka' zhes gces par bslab ces pa ni/ rang bzhin ngan pa'i sems can dang*// sdig ltung drag pos non (163)pa la// rin chen gter dang phrad pa ltar// rnyed par dka' ba gces 'dzin bslab// de la rang bzhin ngan pa ni sngon bsod nams ma bsags pas nyon mongs pa rang dbang med par skyes pa ste rgyal po a saṅga lta bu'am/ yang na 'phrang kha'i mi gcig la sha tshod byin pas kha tshig nas tshod ma snod dang bcas pa bskyur nas nga kha tshig du yod zer ba lta bu'i mi dang*/ sdig pa ni mtshams med pa lnga dang sdom pa nyams pa dang dkor zos la sogs pa'o// sdug bsngal drag pos non pa ni mdze nad drag pos btab pa la sogs pa'o// de dag la mig gis kyang bltar mi rung bas/ ye yong du ma 'jug zer nas dgrar 'dzin te de ltar min te sdug bsngal la gnas pa de snying re rje rgyal po'i gshed mas khrid pa'i mi dang 'dra bas de dag la tshul khrims 'chal ba mthong na yang 'di 'gro ba cir 'gyur zhes mchi ma rab tu dbyung bar bgyi'o zhes gsungs pas de dag la dang po tshig gis lan btab bo// des kyang ma nyan na zas nor gyis phan btags nas bzlog

/des kyang ma phan na bsam pas bzung nas sbyor ba bla gab kyang bsrung ste kho bo la mi phan par bdag la gnod pa yin sdug bsngal drag pos non pa kun la kha cig sna bkab nas 'gro ste de ltar byed kyang bdag la mi 'ong ba'i gding yang med par sbyor ba de la kha zas dang sman la sogs pas phan btags bsam pa la/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci'ang rung*// de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /ces blo sbyong*/ rnyed par dka' zhing gces pa la bslab pa ni/ dper na rin po che dang 'phrad par dka' bas de mi 'dor bar len cing de dag kyang gces par byed pa ltar gang zag de dag rnyed par dka' ba ni de dag la brten nas snying rje skye zhing de la brten nas byang chub kyi sems skye ba yin te/ des na rang gis ma 'bad par (164)theg chen gyi lam bskyed pa'i dmigs yul de lta bu rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ ci'i phyir na 'phags pa dang 'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa la snying rje mi skye bas byang chub kyi sems 'phel mi nus pa'i phyir sangs rgyas mi nus pa yin no// de nyid// byang chub sems ni ma gtogs pa'i// sangs rgyas rnams ni thabs ma gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ rang la skur pa la sogs pa'i nyes skyon gang byung yang dag tshangs mi bya gyong kha rang gis blang ba la bslab ces pa ni// bdag la gzhan gyi phrag dog gis// gshe skur la sogs mi rigs pa'i// gyong kha rang gis len pa dang*// rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul bar bslab ste// rang gis len nam ma len gzhan gyi phrag dog la sogs pas skur pa dang mi snyan par brjod pa ci byung yang mi bzod par mi bya bar rgyud 'jam byas la dag tshangs ngas ma lan 'dis lan zhes mi bya bar gyong kha rang gis blang ba ni glang ri thang pa lta bur bya'o// de nyid ma legs pa su la byung yang de'i gros khong na kho bo yong mchis gsung bar gda'/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni da lta sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la tshul sna tshogs kyis 'bad par byed pa ni sdig pa mang po dag cing tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir byed/

de bas skur pa 'debs pa de bka' drin du shes na snga ma gnyis kyi dod ma yin yang dag tshangs byed na rang gi sdig pa dag dgos gsungs/ gyong kha rang gis blang ba ni las ni steng du 'byung ba yin pas so// glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ 'phan yul gyi dge 'dun la mar tshod sun re drangs pa bas rang la nyes med kyi skur pa 'debs pa la bka' drin che bar shes na sdig pa 'dag pa dang tshogs rdzogs pa'i rlabs de ka che ba yin gsungs so// de nyid spyod 'jug las/ de bas rab tu sdang sems la// brten nas bzod pa skye bas na// (165)de nyid bzod pa'i rgyu yin pas// dam pa'i chos bzhin mchod par 'os// gsungs la de'i 'thad pa ni tshul khrims pas bzod pa bsod nams che ste// zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med// bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'o// drug pa sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa ni/ rang gis sngar phan btags pa'am re che bar bsam pa'i yul des mgo bskor dang sdang bsdos byas na bka' drin che ba'i bsam pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsgom zhes pa ni/ gang la bdag gis phan btags pa'i// re ba che ba gang zhig gis// shin tu mi rigs gnod byas na'ang*// bshes gnyen dam par blta bar bslab ste/ re ba ni/ ston pa na re/ ngas khams su ston pa shes rab 'bar can phyin na khong grogs po snying dang 'dra ba yin pas kho rang gis nga la 'dren gsha' ma byed snyam nas phyin pa dang khong gis sdong bsdos byas nas phud de ci yod 'phrog tu bcug /kho rang gis kyang khri mun nang du bcug song der sngar byams pa dang snying rje la blo sbyangs ma sbyang dang*/ sdug bsngal de dag bdag smin cing*// bdag bde ma lus der smin shog /la sogs brdzun du song ma song der gsal bas de la shag mi gda' rang la ldog nas rtsis na'ang las dang mi ldan na steng du mi yong ste/

bdag gis sngon chad sems can la// 'di 'dra ba yi gnod pa byas// de bas sems can 'tshe byed pas// bdag la gnod pa 'di 'byung rigs// zhes rang gis len pa yin snyam du bsams la rgyud 'jam po byas pas rang bde/ yus ma pho bas gzhan yang bde ba yin/ rang gi las yin/ sdig pa spangs pa'i 'phags pa rnams la sug gnod pa mi byed par (166)'grub pa yin no// gzhan la bzlog na rang gi las ngan gyis kho la gos na bdag la gnod pa byas pas bdag la brten nas 'di ngan song du 'gro ba ni bdag gis lan pa yin te// bdag gi las kyis bskul byas nas// bdag la gnod byed 'di 'byung ste// de yis sems can dmyal dang na// bdag gis de dag ma brlag gam// gsungs pas 'di yi sdug bsngal bskyab par rigs te/ gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// gzhan dag bdag la gnod byed pa'am// de bzhin 'phyar kha gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// ces pa'am/ phan btags lan du gnod byas na'ang*// lan la snying rje chen po bsgom// 'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog ni// nyes pa'i lan ni legs pas ldon// ces so// bka' drin che ba'i bsam pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsgom pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che bas na bdag la khrims phog bsgom lung byin/ thar pa'i lam bstan pas bka' drin che ba ni rang gis ma bsgoms ma bsrungs na lam du mi 'gro la gang zag 'dis bdag la byin nas bdag gi sdig pa 'dag cing tshogs rdzogs par byas nas phan btags nas sgom gyi lung 'bogs mkhan dang khyad par med pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du blta bar bya ste/ de nyid kyang bde ba'i glu las/ dgra'am 'on kyang mdza' yang rung*// nyon mongs skye ba'i yul rnams la// dge bshes yin par sus mthong ba// de dag gang na gnas kyang bde// gsungs pas de lta bu'i bsam pa skyes na blo 'byongs pa yin pas gzhan gang yang med kyang chog gang byas byang chub kyi lam du 'gro ste/

dper na gser gling du mi gtsang ba mi rnyed pa bzhin du'o// dper na chos bya ba rang (167)blo 'chos kyi phyi'i yul 'chos pa ma yin pas mi de la lha 'dre mi gsum dgrar langs kyang de'i rgyud mi dge ba dang sdug bsngal bar mi btub pas sus kyang mi thub pas dpa' bo bya ba yin no// bdun pa ni/ mdor na dngos sam brgyud pas bde ba phan par 'dug pa thams cad ma rgan rnams la dbul zhing de dag gi gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad gus pas rang gi snying gi khongs su blang ba la bslab ces pa ni/ mdor na dngos sam brgyud pa yi// phan bde ma rnams kun la 'bul// ma yi gnod dang sdug bsngal kun// gus pas rang gis len par bslab// mdor bstan ni sngar bstan pa thams cad bsdu ba'o// gus pa ni ma'i drin bsam pa'i sgo nas rang gi khong du blang ba ni kha tsam min par snying thag pa nas gtong len bsgoms te/ dngos su bdag gi bde ba zas dang sman la sogs pa btang ste/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal kun 'byung blangs na phyi ma mngon mtho dang nges legs thob pa'i rgyu yin/ dngos su blang du ma btub pa brgyud nas len pa ni bsam pas gtong len bsgom pa dang smon lam gyis tshe 'di'i bde ba bsngo ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje ba ma byas na// sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing*// 'khor ba na yang bde ba med// ces pa snying thag pa nas brjod do// brgyad pa ni/ de dag thams cad la nyes pa 'byung ba srid pas tshe 'di'i rtog pa dang cung zad kyang ma 'dres par byas shing chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i blos dngos po gang la yang ma chags par slob pa ni// de dag kun kyang chos brgyad kyi// rtog pa'i dri mas ma sbags par// chos rnams sgyu mar shes pa yis// zhen pa'i 'ching las (168)grol bar bslab// ces pa thabs kyi gnyen po ni/ bdag bzang por shes su re ba la sogs pa tshe 'di'i rtog pa dang 'dres pa ni chos brgyad dang rang don du song na chos bdud du shor ba yin pas de sgyu ma lta bur shes nas gdod spang bas da ltar gyi snang ba la bden pa ma grub ste/

'di ltar stong pa'i chos rnams la// thob pa ci yod shor ci yod// gang gis rim gro byas pa'am// yongs su brnyas pa ci zhig yod// bde ba'am sdug bsngal gang las yin// mi dgar ci yod dgar ci yod// ces dang*/ thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar ni// bdag 'dras yongs su bzung bar gyis// zhes so// thams cad la gsol ba smon lam du yang 'debs pa ni bla ma dkon mchog la maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang thugs rje yod na'am khro bo pha bcu ma bcu thams cad la mthu stobs yod pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro la mthu'am nus pa yod na tshig rkang brgyad pa 'di'i don bdag la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung thams cad smin cing bdag gi byang chub kyi sems kyi 'bras bu de dag thams cad sems can thams cad la sbyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bden pa bzhi dang sbyar zhing sbyong ba'o// de dag la sogs pa dge ba ci byas kyi rjes su tshig rkang brgyad ma'i smon lam gdab bo// de'i smon lam btab pas byang chub sems kyi bag chags 'jog go /de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba lo zla ba thams cad du dus thams cad du 'da' bar bya'o// phyi ma'ang de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal ba dang grogs kyang de lta bu dang mjal bar bya'o snyam du bsam zhing smon (169)lam du yang yang gdab par bya'o// re zhig rdzogs so// byang sems glang thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad pa'i 'grel pa ni/ 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rtsa 'grel 'di ni blo sbyong gi man ngag zab mor mchis so// 'di la 'bad 'tshal rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /ā tsa ra gzugs ngan gyi gtam rgyud ni rgya gar du sprang po'i gseb na sgo rgyab tu sdod pa'i ā tsa ra gcig 'dug pa la phrus ma'i thor ma song bas sor sor zer ba gcig gda'o// de'i dus su mu stegs kyi rtsod pa byung bas gzhan gyis ma bzlog

/der khrus ma phod pa na re/ sgo rgyab kyi ā tsa ra ma gi la khrus ma'i thor ma song tsa na sor sor zer ba gcig 'dug ste byas pas de bos pas rtsod pa bzlog ste nang na yon tan su la yod mi shes gsungs so// bza' mi gnyis la rkun ma byung ba ma tshor nas da tshod skas la mi yong snyams nas btang bas phyis nub nas de bas kyang thu ru song ba ltar ro// rgyal po a saṅgha bya bas ā tsa ra gshis ngan gcig jo bo'i drung du rgyun du bsten pas 'di 'dra'i mi mi bsnyen par zhu zhus pas 'di la brten nas bzod pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa yin gsung ngo*// glang thang pa la pham pa dang po'i sgros gcig byung*/ de mi brten na yang ra sgrengs su ja dang 'bul ba la sogs pa'i brgya yus mdzad nas thugs dam la bzhugs so// tshig rkang brgyad ma'i gzer 'debs yin/ 'dzed chen pas// skyabs gnas yul la gus pa lam gyi rten// khas blangs tshul khrims dag pa lam gyi gzhi// tshe 'dir long med bsam pa lam gyi phul// ma tshor pham kha len pa dge sbyong tshul// ces so// dbu ma rtog ge 'bar ba las// rgyal sras khyim pa 'dod spyod kyang*// rab tu byung bas phyag bya'o// zhes gsungs so// mdo sde stan gyi rgyan las// ma 'ongs tha ma'i dus kyi tshe// nga nyid yi (170)ge'i gzugs su 'byung*// zhes so// nags khrod gcig tu ri dwags dang gcan gzan nye bar gnas na ri dwags kyi srog gcod pa bzhin dge slong dang bud med nye bar gnas na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod par nges so// jo bo'i zhal nas/ zla ba phyed kyis bden pa mthong ba'i dge slong gcig gis tshul khrims 'chal ba dang 'grogs na skye ba de la bden pa mi mthong ngo gsung ngo*// des na sdom nyams dang bud med la rgyang ring du bya'o// 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'byung bar shog /theg chen gyi chos zab mo 'di la brten nas lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar gyur cig

/mgon po gser gling pa/ bla ma rin po che yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mgon po gser gling pa'i zhal snga nas jo bo la bu khyod snyigs ma'i dus su gzhan gyi don byed pa la bka' sde snod lung rigs pa bla ma'i man ngag thams cad hril te dril nas stan thog gcig tu nyams su len na nad dang gnod pa dang gdon bgegs dang mu stegs sogs rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i chos 'di rnams dgos te/ 'di skad cig tu/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te// gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// ces pa'i don ni rnam par rtog pa gang byung ba nas 'bur 'joms su bya dgos te/ kho gang na snang*/ dbang po gang gi yul na snang*/ dbyibs dang kha dog ji lta bu zhig snang btsal lo// 'di dug sbrul lam khyi smyon dang 'dra ste nyer mi rung*/ byung 'drog rang la gnyen pos le lo ma (171)shor bar bcom ste/ mdo las/ 'dod pa khyod kyi rtsa ba shes// shin tu rnam rtog dag las byung*// zhes dang*/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed do// ces dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ so so'i skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcings// mi rtog rnal 'byor ba ni grol bar 'gyur// rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin pa// rnam par bcad pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsungs// zhes bya ba la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i bka' bstan bcos thams cad nas byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs chen por bshad pa'i phyir ro// des na le lo ma shor ba gal che'o// 'dir blo mang na mthar mi phyin pas chos zab mo la'ang ma 'joms par 'jug na thams cad rtog pa 'dzin brdal gcig chod du grol dgos te/

mdo las kyang yid la byed pa thams cad bdud las su bshad/ des na ci srid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du tshogs mthong sgom la sogs pa dang las thams cad rtog pa 'bur te byung res kyis gnyen pos 'joms pa la 'gril bar chig chod du bya'o// mdor na rtog pa 'bur te byung res kyis gnyen pos kyang de'i rtsar slebs dgos te/ gnyen pos rnam rtog 'joms pa la 'dun ma thams cad 'gril dgos/ lam thams cad kyang de kho nas bcad dgos so// de'i blang bya gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi yin no// yang 'di skad gsungs te/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen te// 'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin// na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste// sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo long yin// kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// (172)zhes pa'i don ni des na na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i 'gal rkyen gang byung yang des bskul ma byas la de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal yang blos ling ste blangs longs nges snyam du dga' ba'i 'du shes bya// de bzhin du bde skyid la sogs mthun rkyen gang 'dzom yang sems can la byin pas sems can gyi tshogs rdzogs pa la dga' ba'i blo sbyong*/ de bzhin tu gzugs sgra dri ro la sogs pa snang ba'i rkyen gang byung yang btsal bas mi rnyed ma rnyed pa'i don la glong la bzhag pas chos nyid la skul ba'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs yin pas dga' ba bsgom mo// rgyal 'gong bsen mo sa bdag la sogs pa'i gnod pa byung tsa na des bskul ma byas nas sems can thams cad la gnod pa dang sdug bsngal ci yod pa blos lings te blangs longs nges snyam du dga' ba'i 'du shes bya/

gnod byed rnams la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis lus kyi sha khrag gang 'dod sbyin pas byang chub kyi grogs su 'gyur grogs byed pa yin pas gdon thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pas de dag la dga' ba dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom mo// lhag par na tsha byung ba'i dus su sems can thams cad kyi na tsha dang sdug bsngal snying gi dkyil du blangs nas sems can thams cad spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa yin go bcad snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ nad med pa'i dus su des bskul nas rang gi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa 'gro ba la byin pas sems can thams cad kyis rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa yin go bcad snyam du dga' ba sgom pas sdig sgrib kyi phyogs ma yin te/ sdig sgrib skad cig tsam yang bsdad pa'i bzod blag med do// sdug bsngal brgya tham pa byung na tshol thabs (173)brgya tham pa yod/ de yod ma myong bar ma rnyed thabs brgya tham pa yod pas de la spangs pa brgya tham pa rtogs pa brgya tham pa lam khyer te chos nyid kyi yo langs chen po yin te de la dga' ba'i 'du shes bsgom par bya'o// de rnams ni spang bya kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi yin no// yang 'di skad du skyid kyi kha gnon chen po ste// sdug gi mjug sdud chen po yin// ltas ngan g.yang du 'gugs pa yin// mi mkho shos la 'dod thog yin// gnyen po log non gyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// zhes pa'i don ni/ des na dge sbyor gyi gegs su 'gro ba'i bza' btung longs spyod snyan grags la sogs skyid 'dod kyi kha non la 'dod pa chung la chog shes pa'i sgo nas sdug gi mjug sdud de/ rkang pa na na bskor ba bya/ sked pa na na phyag bya/ 'dod pa che na gzhan la sbyin/ g.yeng ba la dga' na mtshams bcad/

long gtam la dga' na smra ba bcad do// gtam ngan nam/ byur shan nam/ byad kha'am/ phur kha la sogs mi 'dod pa'i ltas chen po byung na bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dul ba'i thabs yin pas bkra shis dang g.yang du 'gugs shing da dung thongs shig ces shes pa'i dpa' bskyed la de 'dra'i rigs mi mkho shos thams cad bdag la byung bas da 'di thul na da phyin chad 'khor bar mi skye snyam du de la 'dod thog tu byas te bzod pa gsum la mthu thob par bya'o// de ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i log non gyi chos bzhi yin no// yang 'di skad du/ bdag ni las ngan gyi rtsa ba ste// rgyang ste bskyur ba'i chos shig yin// gzhan ni byang chub 'byung khungs te// bcangs (174)te len pa'i chos shig yin// spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// zhes pa'i don ni/ mdor na bdag mi bde ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas las ngan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas 'di la gces spras ma byed par lings te bskyur la dgra dga' na dgras khyer/ 'dre dga' na 'dres khyer/ mi rings na tshos la bo/ rings na khur du khur la rgyug ces rang thed la btang la sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa ste/ rang don yal bar dor nas brtson pas gzhan don lhur mdzad pa 'di bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 'byung khungs yin pas sems can brtse bas skyong ste sdug bsngal rang la blang ba ni spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos rnam pa gnyis yin te sems can chen po rnams kyi lag len khyad par can yin no// yang 'di skad du/ rgyangs kyis sgyur la lhod kyis klod// shigs kyis shig la 'bol le bzhag /stong nyid kyi rgyas 'debs bzhi yin te// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// de ltar nyams su blang gyur na// skyes bu mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad phar rgyangs te bskur la spros bral chos kyi dbyings su shes pa gsal la rtog pa med par lhod de klod la gang gis kyang ma bcings par bzhag par bya'o// de yang shes pa snga ma'i rjes su mi 'brang*/

ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da lta bar ma bcing bar shig ge bshig /bcas bcos dang sgro skur med/ rang sor 'bol le klod la bzhag ste de ni stong nyid kyi rgyas 'debs pa bzhin no// nyams (175)len de ltar byas na las kyis 'khor bar mi bcing grol bas thar pa thob par 'gyur ro// nyams len 'di las gzhan pa gcig yin na dus snyigs ma'i sems can dmu rgod thul bar mi 'gyur la 'di dang ldan na bar chad kyis mi tshugs pas 'gro don ngang gis 'grub ces gsung ngo*// mnyam med bla ma gser gling pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'o/ a mo gha pā sha'i rgyud las shes rab ni byang chub tu brjod la sems dpa' ni thabs te de gnyis dag gis sems can gyi don nyid 'grub par 'gyur zhes pa dang*/ gsang 'dus grol ba'i thig le las// de nas snying rje 'ba' zhig gis// gzhir gyur yon tan thams cad 'byung*// zhes pa dang*/ rtsa ba snying rje med gyur na// dka' ba bzod par mi nus so// zhes gsungs so// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas chos mang po la bslab par mi bya zhing gcig la bslab par bya gcig po gang zhe na/ snying rje chen po'o// gang la snying rje chen po yod pa de la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du mchis par 'gyur ro// 'bad pa med pa dang rtsol ba med par 'grub par 'gyur ro// mdor na snying rje chen po ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'o// zhes gsungs so// 'gro mgon a ti sha la bla ma gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i don la gdams pa 'di gsungs par gda' 'o// theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong bzhugs// byams pa thogs med la sogs dang*// gser gling pa dang jo bo rje// ston pa pu to sha ra ba// mal gro brag dmar ba la 'dud// spyir (176)blo sbyong ba'i sgo nas sa dang lam la thog ma nas rdo rje theg pa bsgom pa man chad blo sbyong du ma 'dus pa med/

spyi ming bye brag la btags te 'di la jo bo rje'i blo sbyong zhes 'dogs so// jo bo la blo sbyong gdams pa'i srol gsum mnga' ste/ bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta dang*/ bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ gser gling pa'i lugs so// de la 'di bla ma gser gling pa'i lugs te/ 'di'i bdag tu 'dzin pa ma spangs par mngon zhen ma zhi bar byas nas byang chub tu sems bskyed par bzhed pas grub mtha' phyi rol pa dang mthun byas kyang 'gal ba med pa yin gsungs/ gdams pa 'di la dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab par bya gsungs te/ de la rtsis la gdab na bzhi ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ srid pa'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad las log pa rang gzhan gyi 'byor pa lnga lnga dang ldan pas 'di bskal pa bye ba brgya stong du rnyed par dka' ba lung rigs kyi sgo nas bsams la/ rnyed par dka' ba go nas don yod par bya ba ni tshe 'di'i bya ba gang byas kyang de don yod par byas par mi 'gyur bas chos bya/ chos kyi mchog bdag dang gzhan du brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom snyam du bsam/ de ga le bya snyam na thob pa'i dal ba yun ring du mi gnas pas mi rtag pa 'chi ba rjes su dran pa bsgom ste/ sngar skyes pa la ma shi ba med pas kyang 'chi/ tshe 'dzad pas kyang 'chi/ tshe'i mtha' skad cig ma las ma 'das pas 'chi/ nges par chos bya/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i tshe la nges pa dang rang gi 'phen pa ci yod cha med pa dang*/ phyi nang gi rkyen mang bas nam 'chi cha med pas de ring nas chos bya/ de yang 'chi ba la shākya thub byon rung*/ khro (177)bo bzhis bsrung rung*/ nye du mang pos bskor rung*/ rdzas dang yo byad mang po yod kyang cis kyang mi phan pas su yi yang ngo bsrung mi bya bar chos bya/ chos kyi mchog kyang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ shi nas med de cha med snyam na med de mi cha skye dgos/

de yang las kyis skye la/ las dge ba las mtho ris dang thar pa la sogs pa skye/ mi dge bas ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i duḥkha 'byung bas sdig pa sngar byas pa rnams zad par bya/ phyin chad mi bya bar bsdam/ dge ba sngar gyi rnams la gsos gdag phyin chad nus pa yod tshad du bya/ de dag gi mchog kyang bdag dang gzhan du brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems yin pas de bsgom// dge bas mtho ris su skyes kyang bde ba med de 'khor ba mtha' dag duḥkha yin pas 'khor ba mtho dman gyi mdo du ma gyur kyang klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brang ba la nyes dmigs bdun la sogs pa bsams la srid pa mtha' dag las yid 'byung bar byas la de la 'da' bar bya thar pa thob par bya/ de thog mar mi byed na 'khor ba las mi 'da' thar pa thob pa'i gegs bdag tu 'dzin pa yin pas de spang*/ de spong ba'i mchog kyang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin pas de bsgom/ dngos gzhi gtong len spel mar bsgom/ sems can gyi duḥkha kun 'byung bdag la blang*/ bdag gi lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher bsgyur la sems can la btang*/ len pa'i go rim ma nas brtsam gsungs pas rtsa ba'i ma/ pha/ nye du/ yul mi/ yul khams/ bod yul/ 'dzam bu gling gi gling bzhi stong spyi phud stong gnyis bar ma'i stong gsum yungs 'bru bre ru blugs pa tsam du gang du yang des ma khyab pa'i phyogs bcu nam mkha'i (178)khams khyab tshad kyi sems can mdun du bsams la rtsa ba'i ma 'dis dal 'byor byin nas de yang rang blo na gnas dus/ btsas dus/ gsos dus skyes nas zas gos nor gang phongs dgu byin/ bde ba ni lo ka ba'i dbang du byas na 'khor los sgyur ba'am 'das pa'i dbang du byas na sangs rgyas kyi bde ba dang ldan yang nga'i bu la 'di mi 'os snyam pa med par byas/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bsam/ gces pa'i ming gis btags/

duḥkha las bskyabs/ bde ba la nus pa yod tshad du sbyar ba'i drin che bas/ da ngas kyang drin lan du 'di rnams duḥkha las bskyab/ bde ba la dgod/ de yang duḥkhas 'phral lam phugs su gnod/ kun 'byung gis bde mi ster bar 'dug pas de gnyis las dbral snyam du bsams la sems can duḥkha kun 'byung gnyis po ma lus par spyi gris bzhar ba ltar sangs blangs la rang gi snying gi dkyil du gzhug /bdag gi lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher bsgyur la sems can thams cad la btang bas de las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas sems can thams cad la gnas skabs su chos kyi cha rkyen ma tshang ba med pa 'byung zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa la yer gtong bar bsgom pa de gtong len thun gcig bsgom pa'o// de las nges pa skyes shing brtan par gyur na de gnyis dbugs la bskyon par bya ste/ dbugs phyir rgyu ba na gtong la nang du rgyu ba na len par sbyangs te rlung la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'byung mi srid pas blo sbyangs pa dang 'jam rlung 'dzin pa dus gcig 'grub par 'ong*/ de ltar bsgoms pas gtong ba ni byams pa/ len pa ni snying rje/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi duḥkha dang bral zhing bde ba la (179)dgod par 'dod pas dga' ba/ nye ring med pas btang snyoms/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la yer re 'jog pa byang chub kyi sems yin pas gser gling pa'i kun rdzob kyi sems la blo sbyong ba'i gdams pa'o// de rnams sgom pa na skye ma sgom na mi skye ba rnam pa yin/ sgom ma sgom med par skye na chen po yin/ dmigs pa ni yul/ rnam pa ni bsam pa/ bsod nams de'i rnam par smin pa/ de gsum go bzlog pa nas tshad med par 'jog go /de ltar blo sbyongs pa'i dngos gzhi mnyam bzhag de nor ma nor dang skyes ma skyes gtan la 'bebs pa ni rjes kyis shes par byed pas rjes bstan pa ni/ yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/

rjes kyi man ngag mdor bsdus pa'o// rang gi rgyud la yul gsum la brten nas dug gsum skyes pa dang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan brtag dpyad byas nas sems can gyi 'dod chags la sogs pa sangs kyis bdag la blang*/ bdag gi lus rin po cher bsgyur la sems can la btang bas des sems can 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par byas mthar thug sangs rgyas su yer btang*/ dug gsum ji lta bar nga rgyal dang phrag dog la sogs pa nyon mongs pa thams cad la sbyar ro// 'phral la gang 'dug sgom la sbyar/ sems can la 'phral gyi duḥkha dang kun 'byung gi rnam pa zhig su 'dug pa las blang*/ bdag gi lus rin po cher bsgyur la de dag la btang bas 'phral du chos kyi cha rkyen phugs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su yer btang*/ bdag bde ba'i rnam pa la gang snang ba de sems can la btang 'phral phug gi don 'grub par bsam/ spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyong*// spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo ltar tshig tsam (180)du yang sems can gyi sdig sdug thams cad bdag la smin par bsam/ bdag gi bde legs thams cad sems can la smin par gyur cig par bya/ thog mtha' gnyis la sbyor ba gnyis bya/ dang por gang brtsam pa'am sngon du don yod par bya ba'i phyir gtong len byang chub kyi sems bsgom snyam du go cha bsgo/ nyal dus sam rjes nangs par bltas la de grub na dga' ba dang rjes su yi rang bas dga' ba bsgom/ ma grub na gnong bskur bshags gdab bya/ le lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar gyi mi bde ba'am duḥkha thams cad bdag 'dzin las byung bas na 'di la gnod na cis gnod kyang gnod par bya snyam du bsgom/ kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde thams cad yul sems can la brten nas 'byung ste 'phral gyi zas gos la sogs pa'am phug gi rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam bsam pa byang chub kyi sems sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad sems can la brten nas rdzogs su rung gi sems can med na mi rdzogs pas bka' drin du bsgoms la gtong len bsgom/

bkol ba gsum la rtag tu sbyang*/ pha ma mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa drin len du 'os pa dang sdig pa rlabs chen rgyud la yod pa rnams dang snying rje bas phan btags btags pa tshur gnod pa byed du 'ong ba rnams la brten nas rang gi chos 'chor sla bas gsum po de la khyad par du bkol gyin gtong len bsgom/ dbang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung*/ rang gi chos la skyes bu dam pa mi rnams kyis mi khrel ba gang zag gi dpang po dang*/ rang khrel mi khrel lam 'gyod mi 'gyod dang bstun nas bltas pa rang rig pa'i dpang (181)po'o// gnyis po tshad nas thams cad blang*/ rang la duḥkha kun 'byung gnyis mi mkho bar rtogs na drin can gyi sems can thams cad la yang mi mkho bar rtogs par byas la sems can gyi gnyis po bdag la blang*/ bdag gi lus rin po cher bsgyur la sems can la btang 'phral la chos kyi cha rkyen ma tshang ba med pa mthar sangs rgyas su btang*/ dka' ba rnam pa gsum la bslab/ rang gi nyon mongs pas gta' byas nas gtong len bsgoms la/ dang po rgyud la nyon mongs pa skyes pa na ngos zin pa'am dran pas zin par dka'/ bar du nyon mongs pa gnyen pos dbral bar dka'/ tha ma nyon mongs pa tshar chod dka' bas gsum ste/ rtag tu dang po dran pa/ bar du bral ba/ tha ma tshar ci chod bya ba la bslab/ rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang*/ chos byed pa'i sems can la bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba/ rang gi rgyud bkol du rung ba/ zas gos gnas khang nye g.yog la sogs pa mthun rkyen 'dzom pa gsum rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa la de rnams ma 'dzoms pa thams cad bdag la blang*/ bdag gi lus rin po cher bsgyur te dgos 'dod mtha' dag 'byung bar sems can la btang bas sems can thams cad gnas skabs su rkyen gsum po ma tshang ba med par byas/ mthar sangs rgyas su yer btang*/ gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ 'dzom zhing phun sum tshogs par byung yang gtong len la g.yel bar mi bya/

ma 'dzom zhing rgud kyang des zhum nas gtong len sgom pa bar mi bcad par bya/ chos rnams dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba rjes dran/ las rgyu 'bras/ srid pa'i nyes dmigs/ byams snying rje byang chub (182)kyi sems pha rol tu phyin pa drug bdag med gnyis bsgom pa thams cad kyi dgos pa bdag 'dzin 'di nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas spang ba dang*/ gzhan gces 'dzin gyi byang chub kyi sems 'di yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pas sgrub chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am dgongs pa de las mi mnga'/ shag ngan ma dgod// byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi don byed pas ngag tu rtsub mo mi gdon/ yus mi sgom/ byang chub sems dpas sems can gyi don byed pa de las sam bya rgyu byas pa yin pas lan tu/ gzhan la yus che rgyu med pas yus mi sgom/ ko long ma sdom/ byang chub sems dpa' la gzhan gyis nyes pa byas pa ni byang chub lag mthil du gtod du byung ba yin pas dga' ba bsgom gyi ko long mi sdom 'or che spang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi don byas pa de rang gi las sam bya ba byas pa yin pas lan la ma re tha ma 'or che'o byas pa tsam la yang mi blta/ 'phrang sgug mi bya sems can 'dis bdag la nyes pa 'di dang 'di byas snyam pa'i ngan lan gyi 'phrang ma sgug /gzhung bzang mi bsten/ 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa thog ma med pa nas 'bral ma myong ba de dang gtong len byang chub kyi sems sgom pa de 'gal bas de yang spang*/ mgyogs kyi rtse mi gtod/ rang byang chub pa'i bsgrub bya sngon la sgrub pa dang byang chub sems 'gal ba de spangs/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo/ nyes pa thams cad bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung ba yin te nyes gyod gzhan la mi bkal/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug mi btsal skyid pa'am bde ba 'dod na de'i rgyu'am yan lag tu tshong dang bzo dang so nam la sogs pa byed pa de'ang bdag 'dzin kho na'i phyir byed de des bde skyid mi rnyed/

rkyen la ltos pa med par (183)sbyang*/ gtong len byang chub kyi sems sgom pa ni rkyen legs shes sam nyes shes la ltos nas sgom pa'i nges pa med de legs par mthong rung nyes par mthong rung gang snang snang rgyu mtshan du byas nas bsgom// rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ chos gang bsgoms kyang gtong len byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i cha rkyen du khyer la bya/ log na gnyen por de nyid bsam/ sgom skyon la sogs pa byung na gnyen po la sogs pa gzhan nas mi tshol bar gtong len kho na bsgom/ 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ lus kyis 'grub tshad phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa/ ngag gis smra tshad mdo dang snying po la sogs pa/ yid kyis sems tshad lha sgom pa la sogs pa gang byed kyang dmigs pa gtong len las mi 'da' bar bya/ lha sgom lta bu la sa bon la sogs pa'i spro bsdu thams cad gtong len bsgom na rnal 'byor gyi mchog go /gnyis po srog dang bsdo ba las/ gtong len gyi sems bsgom pa srog dang bsdos la'ang bya ste do gal che ba'i tshad do// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag spyi dang mthun/ gtong len byang chub kyi sems kyi gdams pa ston pa'i bla ma shin tu gnyan pas dam tshig bsrung ba shin tu dka' ste/ sngags sam phar phyin gyi gzhung bla ma lnga bcu pa la sogs pa gzhan dang mthun no// spyi don gsum la bslab par bya/ gtong len bsgom pa de'ang spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang mi 'gal ba/ khyad par du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' srol dang mi 'gal ba/ bye brag tu yang rang gi khas blangs kyi bslab sdom thams cad mi 'gal bar blo sbyong nyams pa med pa rnam pa gsum bsten/ byin rlabs la re dgos pas bla ma la dad (184)gus nyams pa med pa// goms pa las dbang du gyur ba'i gtong len byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la 'dun pa nyams pa med pa/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma tshul khrims dag pa las byung ba yin pas rang gis khas blangs pa'i bslab sdom rnams nyams pa med par blo sbyang*/

yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ rang gis dag par bsrungs kyang mi stongs kyang cha bas rang gis dag par srung ba'i yan lag yin pas gzhan ji ltar yang nyes skyon brjod par mi bya/ gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo// legs nyes yin min bde sdug thog tu byung ba la brten nas de ka rgyu mtshan du byas shing blo sbyong dgos pas spang bya 'di gnyen po 'di phyogs su chad pa med par thams cad la brten la gtong len bya/ res 'jog mi bya/ nyams sad lta bus blo mi 'byongs pas dus rtag tu gtong lan byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba la snying phur btab pa 'drar blo sbyang*/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni grangs med gsum gyis bsgrub dgos pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni yud tsam mam tshig gcig gam bskal pa gcig tsam gyis mthar mi phyin pas yun bsrings la bsgom/ dol chod du sbyang*/ bdag gi lus la sogs pa gtong ba dang gzhan gyi duḥkha thams cad bdag la len pa de ngas nus sam mi nus snyam du nyams sad pa tsam gyis mi yong bas rtsa phran chad pa ltar ram/ khal do bcad pa ltar ram/ la bcad du sbyang*/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyis thar bar bya/ yang gtong len rgyud la skyes snyams pa'i brtan pa yod snyams byed na nyon mongs pa skye ba'i yul dang 'phrad pa'am/ sems can duḥkha can dang 'phrad pa'am/ bdag la bde ba'am/ duḥkha skyes pa nas gtong nus sam mi nus/ len nus sam mi nus nyon mongs pa'i gnyen (185)por song ma song steng nas zhun thar gsal bar dbyung*/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ legs nyes ci byung rung bde sdug ci la thug kyang gtong len byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i cha rkyen nam gta' ma grogs su mi 'gyur ba med pas ci byung yang dga' ba kho nar bya'i sdug bsngal du gyur pa'i rgyu ma grub bo// 'bras bu re ba thams cad spang*/ gtong len byang chub kyi sems sbyangs pa la gnas skabs kyi phan yon nam mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'am/

dga' ba byung na rang gi don du bde ba'am 'bras bu 'grub la re ba thams cad spang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du gzhan bde dang gzhan ched kho nar blo sbyong*/ go log mi bya/ 'dun pa go log mi bya ste/ rang don gyi 'dun pa spang ba gzhan don 'ba' zhig tu blo sbyong*/ snying rje go log brnyas thabs sam khyad gsod kyi snying rje spangs la brtse sems kyis mi bzod pa bsgom/ bzod pa go log rang 'dod kyi phyir duḥkha bzod pa spangs la gzhan ched du byang chub bsgrub pa'i duḥkha bzod par bya/ brtson 'grus go log 'dod yon gyi phyir smad pa'i brtson pa'am rang don gyi brtson pa spangs la gzhan don sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam/ ro myong ba go log rang 'dod grub pas dga' ba spangs la gzhan don grub pa la dga' ba bsgom/ rjes su yi rang ba go log sems can nyes pa byung ba la yi rang ba spangs la bde legs su gyur ba la yid rang ba bsgom/ gnad la mi dbab/ stobs la sogs pa yod pa'i gang zag yin na mi'am mi ma yin pa la gzir ba'am gnad la dbab pa mi bya/ lha bdud du mi dbab/ gtong len byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yon tan gyi rang bzhin yin pa la/ de la nga rgyal byas na skyon gyi (186)gzhi mar chabs de mi bya/ rgyu'i gtso bo ngos bzung*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i sems can rgyu'i gtso bo gtong len nam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin gyi lus ngag gi mngon mngon pos mi phan des na lus ngag tu mi gdon yengs thub par bya'o// dus rtag tu bsam pa gtong len byang chub kyi sems pa la ma yengs par blo sbyong*/ gdod log mi bya/ lus gzhan la gtong ba de kha tsam tshig tsam min pas zhe thag pas btang*/ gzhan gyi sdig sdug bdag la len pa de kha tsam tshig tsam min pas zhe thag pas dngos su blangs la des bdag 'gas pa'am 'phir ba'am brlag pa tsam du gyur bar bsgom/

de rnams bsdus nas bsgom pa ni/ stobs lnga dag la sbyor bar bya/ gtong len bsgom pa'i 'dun pa rgyun mi 'chad du yid la byed pa ni 'phen pa'i stobs so// gtong len byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye ba'i phyir mchod pa bsnyen bkur gtor ma la sogs pa byed pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba dkar po'i sa bon bsags pa'i stobs so// gtong len byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye ba'i phyir bla ma dkon mchog la sogs pa la gsol ba 'debs/ rang gi smon lam rgyun du 'debs pa ni smon lam gyi stobs so// dus rtag tu gtong len byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la blo goms pas nyams su myong zhing rang dbang du gyur pa ni goms pa'i stobs so// gtong len de lta bu bsgom par mi nus snyam du bdag gces 'dzin gyi blo byung na de tshar gcod pa ni sun 'byin pa'i stobs so// 'chi khar bsgom pa dang 'chi bar 'dug pas bar do thams cad du gtong len byang chub kyi sems mtshan nyid pa ci skye snyam du bsgom pa ni 'phen pa'i stobs so// ka cha spong dag 'os pa la gtong*/ mchod pa/ gtor ma/ bsnyen (187)bkur 'os pa byed pa la sogs pa dkar po dge bsags sa bon gyi stobs so// bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ chos skyong la bar do man chad du gtong len byang chub kyi sems skye bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs/ rang yang de ltar smon lam 'debs pa smon lam gyi stobs so// 'chi ka'i gdams pa'i gsos 'debs bya'o// 'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor zhog /gtong len sgom pa la 'dun pa bsgyur bar byed pa de lta bus lam mi chod zer ba la sogs pa byung na rang gi shes pa mi 'gyur bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i rtsa ba'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir// snyigs ma lnga po rab rgyas pa// byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin// snyigs ma lnga'i dus phyin ci log rgyas pa nyon mongs pa shas che bas nyon mongs pa ci skyes thams cad byang chub lam du sgyur byed pa/

gtong len gyi grogs sam gta' ma'am cha rkyen du sgyur bar byed pa'o// man ngag bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'di// sde snod thams cad kyi bcud tig pa'i nying khu'o// dam pa dag las brgyud pa yin// byams pa nas/ gser gling pa/ a ti sha/ dge bshes ston pa/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ mal gro ba/ brag dmar ba'o// de rnams la lta ba/ spyod pa/ dam tshig /tshul khrims la sogs pa gang la yang skyon nam lhad dam zol med pas dam pa'o// de dag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa/ bdag gzhan brjes nas gtong len gyi byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la snang grags yin min phog thug thams cad kyi sems sbyong ba'i cha rkyen du khyer nas blo sbyong bar byed pa'i gdams ngag go /blo sbyong gdams ngag rdzogs so// dge'o// sarba dā maṅga lam/ (188)
